   172→def build_synthesis_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   173→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``synthesis::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   174→
   175→    Returns an empty list when no synthesis stages are pending.
   176→    """
   177→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.synthesis_playbook import (
   178→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   179→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS,
   180→    )
   181→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   182→        SYNTHESIS_IDS,
   183→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS,
   184→    )
   185→
   186→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   187→    order_set = set(order)
   188→    present = order_set & SYNTHESIS_IDS
   189→    if not present:
   190→        return []
   191→
   192→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   193→    confirmed = set(meta.get("synthesis_stages", {}).keys())
   194→
   195→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   196→    open_review_count = sum(
   197→        1 for f in findings.values()
   198→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   199→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   200→    )
   201→
   202→    label_map = dict(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS)
   203→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   204→
   205→    items: list[dict] = []
   206→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   207→        if sid not in present:
   208→            continue
   209→        if name in confirmed:
   210→            continue
   211→
   212→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   213→        deps = SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   214→        blocked_by = sorted(
   215→            f"synthesis::{dep}" for dep in deps
   216→            if f"synthesis::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   217→        )
   218→
   219→        cmd = f"desloppify plan synthesize --stage {name}"
   220→        if name == "commit":
   221→            cmd = 'desloppify plan synthesize --complete --strategy "..."'
   222→
   223→        items.append({
   224→            "id": sid,
   225→            "tier": 1,
   226→            "confidence": "high",
   227→            "detector": "synthesis",
   228→            "file": ".",
   229→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   230→            "stage_name": name,
   231→            "stage_index": idx,
   232→            "summary": f"Planning: {label_map.get(name, name)}",
   233→            "detail": {
   234→                "total_review_findings": open_review_count,
   235→                "stage": name,
   236→                "stage_label": label_map.get(name, name),
   237→            },
   238→            "primary_command": cmd,
   239→            "blocked_by": blocked_by,
   240→            "is_blocked": bool(blocked_by),
   241→        })
   242→    return items
   243→
   244→
   245→def build_create_plan_item(plan: dict) -> dict | None:
   246→    """Build a synthetic work item for ``workflow::create-plan`` if it's in the queue.
   247→
   248→    Returns ``None`` when the item is not pending.
   249→    """
   250→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID
   251→
   252→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   253→        return None
   254→
   255→    return {
   256→        "id": WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID,
   257→        "tier": 1,

   260→        "file": ".",

   262→        "summary": "Create prioritized plan from review results",
   263→        "detail": {},
   264→        "primary_command": "desloppify plan",
   265→        "blocked_by": [],

   267→    }

   270→def subjective_strict_scores(state: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
   271→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   272→    if not dim_scores:
   273→        return {}
   274→
   275→    entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   276→    scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   277→    for entry in entries:
   278→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   279→        if not name:
   280→            continue
   281→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   282→        [REDACTED](name)
   283→        aliases = _subjective_dimension_aliases(name)
   284→        for cli_key in entry.get("cli_keys", []):
   285→            key = str(cli_key).strip().lower()
   286→            if not key:
   287→                continue
   288→            aliases.add(key)
   289→            aliases.add(slugify(key))
   290→        aliases.add(dim_key.lower())
   291→        aliases.add(slugify(dim_key))
   292→        for alias in aliases:
   293→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   294→    return scores
   295→
   296→
   297→def _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores: dict) -> list[dict]:
   298→    """Build scorecard-like entries for unassessed placeholder dimensions.
   299→
   300→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` goes through the scorecard pipeline which
   301→    intentionally hides placeholders from display.  This function reads
   302→    ``dimension_scores`` directly so initial-review items are never lost.
   303→    """
   304→    entries: list[dict] = []
   305→    for name, data in dim_scores.items():
   306→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   307→            continue
   308→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   309→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
   310→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
   311→            continue
   312→        if not meta.get("placeholder"):
   313→            continue
   314→        dim_key = meta.get("dimension_key", "")
   315→        entries.append(
   316→            {
   317→                "name": name,
   318→                "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
   319→                "strict": float(data.get("strict", 0.0)),
   320→                "checks": int(data.get("checks", 0) or 0),
   321→                "issues": int(data.get("issues", 0) or 0),
   322→                "tier": int(data.get("tier", 4) or 4),
   323→                "placeholder": True,
   324→                "stale": False,
   325→                "dimension_key": dim_key,
   326→                "cli_keys": [dim_key] if dim_key else [],
   327→            }
   328→        )
   329→    return entries
   330→
   331→
   332→def build_subjective_items(
   333→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   334→) -> list[dict]:
   335→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   336→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   337→    if not dim_scores:
   338→        return []
   339→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   340→
   341→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   342→
   343→    # The scorecard pipeline hides unassessed placeholders from display.
   344→    # Merge them in so initial-review items always appear in the queue.
   345→    seen_dims: set[str] = {
   346→        str(e.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   347→        for e in subjective_entries
   348→        if e.get("dimension_key")
   349→    }
   350→    for entry in _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores):
   351→        dk = str(entry.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   352→        if dk and dk not in seen_dims:
   353→            subjective_entries.append(entry)
   354→            seen_dims.add(dk)
   355→
   356→    if not subjective_entries:
   357→        return []
   358→    unassessed_dims = {
   359→        str(name).strip()
   360→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   361→            dim_scores
   362→        )
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   366→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   367→    for finding in findings.values():
   368→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   369→            continue
   370→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   371→        if not dim_key:
   372→            continue
   373→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   374→
   375→    items: list[dict] = []
   376→    def _prepare_command(
   377→        cli_keys: list[str],
   378→        *,
   379→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   380→    ) -> str:
   381→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   382→        if cli_keys:
   383→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   384→        if force_review_rerun:
   385→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   386→        return command
   387→
   388→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   389→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   390→        if not name:
   391→            continue
   392→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   393→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   394→            continue
   395→
   396→        [REDACTED](name)
   397→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   398→        cli_keys = [
   399→            str(key).strip().lower()
   400→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   401→            if str(key).strip()
   402→        ]
   403→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   404→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   405→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   406→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   407→            name in unassessed_dims
   408→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   409→        )
   410→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   411→        _ = open_review  # used below for command selection
   412→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   413→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   414→        if open_review > 0:
   415→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   416→        elif is_unassessed:
   417→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   418→        elif is_stale:
   419→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   420→                cli_keys,
   421→                force_review_rerun=True,
   422→            )
   423→        elif cli_keys:
   424→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   425→                cli_keys,
   426→                force_review_rerun=True,
   427→            )
   428→        else:
   429→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   430→                cli_keys,
   431→                force_review_rerun=True,
   432→            )
   433→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   434→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   435→        items.append(
   436→            {
   437→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   438→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   439→                "file": ".",
   440→                "confidence": "medium",
   441→                "summary": summary,
   442→                "detail": {
   443→                    "dimension_name": name,
   444→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   445→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   446→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   447→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   448→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   449→                },
   450→                "status": "open",
   451→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   452→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   453→                "backlog_gated": is_backlog_gated,
   454→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   455→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   456→            }
   457→        )
   458→    return items
   459→

1→"""Shared plan constants and helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→CONFIDENCE_ORDER = {"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2}
     6→
     7→
     8→def is_subjective_phase(phase) -> bool:
     9→    """Return True when a phase is subjective/review oriented."""
    10→    label = (phase.label or "").lower()
    11→    run_name = getattr(phase.run, "__name__", "").lower()
    12→    return (
    13→        "subjective" in label
    14→        or "review" in label
    15→        or run_name == "phase_subjective_review"
    16→    )
    17→

1→"""Queue-policy helpers shared by planning render/select modules."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→from typing import Any
     7→

     9→    QueueBuildOptions,
    10→    WorkQueueResult,
    11→    build_work_queue,
    12→)
    13→
    14→
    15→def _subjective_threshold(state: dict[str, Any], *, default: float = 95.0) -> float:
    16→    config = state.get("config", {})
    17→    raw_target = default
    18→    if isinstance(config, dict):
    19→        raw_target = config.get("target_strict_score", default)
    20→    try:
    21→        value = float(raw_target)
    22→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    23→        value = default
    24→    return max(0.0, min(100.0, value))
    25→
    26→
    27→@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    28→class OpenPlanQueuePolicy:
    29→    count: int | None = None
    30→    scan_path: str | None = None
    31→    include_subjective: bool = True
    32→
    33→
    34→def build_open_plan_queue(
    35→    state: dict[str, Any],
    36→    policy: OpenPlanQueuePolicy | None = None,
    37→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    38→    """Build one open-status queue with consistent planning policy defaults."""
    39→    policy = policy or OpenPlanQueuePolicy()
    40→    resolved_scan_path: str | None
    41→    if isinstance(policy.scan_path, str):
    42→        resolved_scan_path = policy.scan_path
    43→    else:
    44→        raw_state_path = state.get("scan_path")
    45→        resolved_scan_path = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, str) else None
    46→    return build_work_queue(
    47→        state,
    48→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    49→            count=policy.count,
    50→            scan_path=resolved_scan_path,
    51→            status="open",
    52→            include_subjective=policy.include_subjective,
    53→            subjective_threshold=_subjective_threshold(state),
    54→        ),
    55→    )
    56→
    57→
    58→__all__ = ["OpenPlanQueuePolicy", "build_open_plan_queue"]
    59→

   179→def _plan_item_sections(findings: dict, *, state: PlanState | None = None) -> list[str]:
   180→    """Build per-file sections from the shared work-queue backend."""
   181→
   182→    queue_state: PlanState | dict = state or {"findings": findings}
   183→    scan_path = state.get("scan_path") if state else None
   184→    raw_target = (
   185→        (state or {}).get("config", {}).get("target_strict_score", 95)
   186→        if isinstance(state, dict)
   187→        else 95
   188→    )
   189→    try:
   190→        subjective_threshold = float(raw_target)
   191→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   192→        subjective_threshold = 95.0
   193→    subjective_threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold))
   194→    if "findings" not in queue_state:
   195→        queue_state = {**queue_state, "findings": findings}
   196→
   197→    queue = build_work_queue(
   198→        queue_state,
   199→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   200→            count=None,
   201→            scan_path=scan_path,
   202→            status="open",
   203→            include_subjective=True,
   204→            subjective_threshold=subjective_threshold,
   205→        ),
   206→    )
   207→    open_items = queue.get("items", [])
   208→    by_file: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
   209→    for item in open_items:
   210→        by_file[item.get("file", ".")].append(item)
   211→
   212→    lines: list[str] = []
   213→    total_count = len(open_items)
   214→    if not open_items:
   215→        return lines
   216→
   217→    lines.extend([
   218→        "---",
   219→        f"## Open Items ({total_count})",
   220→        "",
   221→    ])
   222→
   223→    sorted_files = sorted(
   224→        by_file.items(), key=lambda item: (-len(item[1]), item[0])
   225→    )
   226→    for filepath, file_items in sorted_files:
   227→        display_path = "Codebase-wide" if filepath == "." else filepath
   228→        lines.append(f"### `{display_path}` ({len(file_items)} findings)")
   229→        lines.append("")
   230→        for item in file_items:
   231→            if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
   232→                lines.append(f"- [ ] [subjective] {item.get('summary', '')}")
   233→                lines.append(f"      `{item.get('id', '')}`")
   234→                if item.get("primary_command"):
   235→                    lines.append(f"      action: `{item['primary_command']}`")
   236→                continue
   237→
   238→            conf_badge = f"[{item.get('confidence', 'medium')}]"
   239→            lines.append(f"- [ ] {conf_badge} {item.get('summary', '')}")
   240→            lines.append(f"      `{item.get('id', '')}`")
   241→        lines.append("")
   242→
   243→    return lines
   244→
   245→
   246→def generate_plan_md(state: PlanState, plan: dict | None = None) -> str:
   247→    """Generate a prioritized markdown plan from state.
   248→
   249→    When *plan* is provided (or auto-loaded from disk), user-ordered
   250→    items, clusters, skipped, and superseded sections are rendered.
   251→    When no plan exists, output is identical to the previous behavior.
   252→    """
   253→    findings = state["findings"]
   254→    stats = state.get("stats", {})
   255→
   256→    # Auto-load plan if not provided
   257→    if plan is None:
   258→        try:
   259→            from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   260→            plan = load_plan()
   261→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   262→            plan = {}
   263→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   264→        plan = {}
   265→    plan.setdefault("queue_order", [])
   266→    plan.setdefault("skipped", {})
   267→    plan.setdefault("clusters", {})
   268→
   269→    has_plan = bool(
   270→        plan
   271→        and (
   272→            plan.get("queue_order")
   273→            or plan.get("skipped")
   274→            or plan.get("clusters")
   275→        )
   276→    )
   277→
   278→    lines = _plan_header(state, stats)
   279→    lines.extend(_plan_dimension_table(state))
   280→    lines.extend(_summary_lines(stats))
   281→
   282→    if has_plan:
   283→        # Build full queue for item lookup
   284→        queue = build_work_queue(
   285→            state,
   286→            options=QueueBuildOptions(
   287→                count=None,
   288→                scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   289→                status="open",
   290→                include_subjective=True,
   291→            ),
   292→        )
   293→        all_items = queue.get("items", [])
   294→        lines.extend(_plan_user_ordered_section(all_items, plan))
   295→
   296→        # Remaining: items NOT in queue_order or skipped
   297→        ordered_ids = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   298→        skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   299→        plan_ids = ordered_ids | skipped_ids
   300→        remaining = [item for item in all_items if item.get("id") not in plan_ids]
   301→        if remaining:
   302→            lines.append("---")
   303→            lines.append(f"## Remaining (mechanical order, {len(remaining)} items)")
   304→            lines.append("")
   305→
   306→        lines.extend(_plan_item_sections(findings, state=state))
   307→        lines.extend(_plan_skipped_section(all_items, plan))
   308→        lines.extend(_plan_superseded_section(plan))
   309→    else:
   310→        lines.extend(_plan_item_sections(findings, state=state))
   311→
   312→    lines.extend(_addressed_section(findings))
   313→
   314→    return "\n".join(lines)
   315→

1→"""Finding prioritization/selection helpers for next items."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations

     5→from desloppify.engine.planning.types import PlanItem, PlanState
     6→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import (

    10→
    11→
    12→def get_next_items(
    13→    state: PlanState,
    14→    tier: int | None = None,
    15→    count: int = 1,
    16→    scan_path: str | None = None,
    17→) -> list[PlanItem]:
    18→    """Get the N highest-priority open findings.
    19→
    20→    Legacy plan API intentionally returns only finding items (not synthetic
    21→    subjective queue items) so existing planner consumers stay stable.
    22→    The *tier* parameter is accepted for backward compatibility but ignored.
    23→    """
    24→    result = build_work_queue(
    25→        state,
    26→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    27→            count=count,
    28→            scan_path=scan_path,
    29→            status="open",
    30→            include_subjective=False,
    31→        ),
    32→    )
    33→    return [item for item in result["items"] if item.get("kind") == "finding"]
    34→
    35→
    36→def get_next_item(
    37→    state: PlanState,
    38→    tier: int | None = None,
    39→    scan_path: str | None = None,
    40→) -> PlanItem | None:
    41→    """Get the highest-priority open finding."""
    42→    items = get_next_items(state, tier=tier, count=1, scan_path=scan_path)
    43→    return items[0] if items else None

    29→def path_scoped_findings(
    30→    findings: dict[str, Finding],
    31→    scan_path: str | None,
    32→) -> dict[str, Finding]:
    33→    """Filter findings to those within the given scan path."""
    34→    return {
    35→        finding_id: finding
    36→        for finding_id, finding in findings.items()
    37→        if finding_in_scan_scope(str(finding.get("file", "")), scan_path)
    38→    }
    39→
    40→
    41→def finding_in_scan_scope(file_path: str, scan_path: str | None) -> bool:
    42→    """Return True when a file path belongs to the active scan scope."""
    43→    if not scan_path or scan_path == ".":
    44→        return True
    45→    prefix = scan_path.rstrip("/") + "/"
    46→    return (
    47→        file_path.startswith(prefix)
    48→        or file_path == scan_path
    49→        or file_path == "."
    50→    )
    51→
    52→
    53→def open_scope_breakdown(
    54→    findings: dict[str, Finding],
    55→    scan_path: str | None,
    56→    *,
    57→    detector: str | None = None,
    58→) -> dict[str, int]:
    59→    """Return open-finding counts split by in-scope vs out-of-scope carryover."""
    60→    in_scope = 0
    61→    out_of_scope = 0
    62→
    63→    for finding in findings.values():
    64→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    65→            continue
    66→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    67→            continue
    68→        if detector is not None and finding.get("detector") != detector:
    69→            continue
    70→        file_path = str(finding.get("file", ""))
    71→        if finding_in_scan_scope(file_path, scan_path):
    72→            in_scope += 1
    73→        else:
    74→            out_of_scope += 1
    75→
    76→    return {
    77→        "in_scope": in_scope,
    78→        "out_of_scope": out_of_scope,
    79→        "global": in_scope + out_of_scope,
    80→    }
    81→
    82→
    83→def is_ignored(finding_id: str, file: str, ignore_patterns: list[str]) -> bool:
    84→    """Check if a finding matches any ignore pattern (glob, ID prefix, or file path)."""
    85→    return matched_ignore_pattern(finding_id, file, ignore_patterns) is not None
    86→
    87→
    88→def matched_ignore_pattern(
    89→    finding_id: str, file: str, ignore_patterns: list[str]
    90→) -> str | None:
    91→    """Return the ignore pattern that matched, if any."""
    92→    for pattern in ignore_patterns:
    93→        if "*" in pattern:
    94→            target = finding_id if "::" in pattern else file
    95→            if fnmatch.fnmatch(target, pattern):
    96→                return pattern
    97→            continue
    98→
    99→        if "::" in pattern:
   100→            if finding_id.startswith(pattern):
   101→                return pattern
   102→            continue
   103→
   104→        raw_base = pattern.rstrip("/")
   105→        rel_base = rel(pattern).rstrip("/")
   106→        for base in (raw_base, rel_base):
   107→            if not base:
   108→                continue
   109→            if file == base or file.startswith(base + "/"):
   110→                return pattern
   111→
   112→    return None
   113→
   114→
   115→def remove_ignored_findings(state: StateModel, pattern: str) -> int:
   116→    """Suppress findings matching an ignore pattern. Returns count affected."""
   117→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   118→    matched_ids = [
   119→        finding_id
   120→        for finding_id, finding in state["findings"].items()
   121→        if is_ignored(finding_id, finding["file"], [pattern])
   122→    ]
   123→    now = utc_now()
   124→    for finding_id in matched_ids:
   125→        finding = state["findings"][finding_id]
   126→        finding["suppressed"] = True
   127→        finding["suppressed_at"] = now
   128→        finding["suppression_pattern"] = pattern
   129→    # Deferred import to avoid circular dependency with engine._state.scoring
   130→    from desloppify.engine._state.scoring import _recompute_stats
   131→
   132→    _recompute_stats(state, scan_path=state.get("scan_path"))
   133→    validate_state_invariants(state)
   134→    return len(matched_ids)
   135→
   136→
   137→def add_ignore(state: StateModel, pattern: str) -> int:
   138→    """Add an ignore pattern and remove existing matching findings."""
   139→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   140→    config = state.setdefault("config", {})
   141→    ignores = config.setdefault("ignore", [])
   142→    if pattern not in ignores:
   143→        ignores.append(pattern)
   144→    return remove_ignored_findings(state, pattern)
   145→
   146→
   147→def make_finding(
   148→    detector: str,
   149→    file: str,
   150→    name: str,
   151→    *,
   152→    tier: int,
   153→    confidence: str,
   154→    summary: str,
   155→    detail: dict | None = None,
   156→) -> Finding:
   157→    """Create a normalized finding dict with a stable ID."""
   158→    rfile = rel(file)
   159→    finding_id = f"{detector}::{rfile}::{name}" if name else f"{detector}::{rfile}"
   160→    now = utc_now()
   161→    return {
   162→        "id": finding_id,
   163→        "detector": detector,
   164→        "file": rfile,
   165→        "tier": tier,
   166→        "confidence": confidence,
   167→        "summary": summary,
   168→        "detail": detail or {},
   169→        "status": "open",
   170→        "note": None,
   171→        "first_seen": now,
   172→        "last_seen": now,
   173→        "resolved_at": None,
   174→        "reopen_count": 0,
   175→    }
   176→
   177→
   178→_HEX8_RE = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{8}$')
   179→
   180→
   181→def _matches_pattern(finding_id: str, finding: dict[str, str], pattern: str) -> bool:
   182→    """Check if a finding matches by ID, glob, prefix, detector, suffix, or path."""
   183→    if finding_id == pattern:
   184→        return True
   185→    if "*" in pattern and fnmatch.fnmatch(finding_id, pattern):
   186→        return True
   187→    if "::" in pattern and finding_id.startswith(pattern):
   188→        return True
   189→    if _HEX8_RE.match(pattern) and finding_id.endswith("::" + pattern):
   190→        return True
   191→    if (
   192→        finding.get("detector") == pattern
   193→        or finding["file"] == pattern
   194→        or finding["file"].startswith(pattern.rstrip("/") + "/")
   195→    ):
   196→        return True
   197→
   198→    # Name-segment fallback: bare name matches the last ::segment of the ID
   199→    if "::" not in pattern and "::" in finding_id:
   200→        segments = finding_id.split("::")
   201→        name_segment = segments[-1]
   202→        if name_segment == pattern:
   203→            return True
   204→        # For hashed IDs, also match the descriptive name (second-to-last segment)
   205→        if len(segments) >= 3 and _HEX8_RE.match(name_segment) and segments[-2] == pattern:
   206→            return True
   207→
   208→    return False
   209→

   312→    has_active_checks = any((count or 0) > 0 for count in merged.values())
   313→    if not has_active_checks and not subjective_assessments:

   316→        state["objective_score"] = 100.0

   321→    # Use the full scorecard dimensions for 0-score placeholders so every

   431→def suppression_metrics(state: StateModel, *, window: int = 5) -> dict[str, int | float]:
   432→    """Summarize ignore suppression from recent scan history."""
   433→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
   434→    if not history:
   435→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   436→
   437→    scans_with_suppression = [
   438→        entry
   439→        for entry in history
   440→        if isinstance(entry, dict)
   441→        and (
   442→            "ignored" in entry
   443→            or "raw_findings" in entry
   444→            or "suppressed_pct" in entry
   445→            or "ignore_patterns" in entry
   446→        )
   447→    ]
   448→    if not scans_with_suppression:
   449→        return _empty_suppression_metrics()
   450→
   451→    recent = scans_with_suppression[-max(1, window) :]
   452→    last = recent[-1]
   453→
   454→    recent_ignored = sum(int(entry.get("ignored", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   455→    recent_raw = sum(int(entry.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0) for entry in recent)
   456→    recent_pct = round(recent_ignored / recent_raw * 100, 1) if recent_raw else 0.0
   457→
   458→    last_ignored = int(last.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   459→    last_raw = int(last.get("raw_findings", 0) or 0)
   460→    if "suppressed_pct" in last:
   461→        last_pct = round(float(last.get("suppressed_pct") or 0.0), 1)
   462→    else:
   463→        last_pct = round(last_ignored / last_raw * 100, 1) if last_raw else 0.0
   464→
   465→    return {
   466→        "last_ignored": last_ignored,
   467→        "last_raw_findings": last_raw,
   468→        "last_suppressed_pct": last_pct,
   469→        "last_ignore_patterns": int(last.get("ignore_patterns", 0) or 0),
   470→        "recent_scans": len(recent),
   471→        "recent_ignored": recent_ignored,
   472→        "recent_raw_findings": recent_raw,
   473→        "recent_suppressed_pct": recent_pct,
   474→    }
   475→

    38→def compute_dimension_scores_by_mode(
    39→    findings: dict,

    41→    *,
    42→    subjective_assessments: dict | None = None,
    43→    allowed_subjective_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    44→) -> dict[ScoreMode, dict[str, dict]]:
    45→    """Compute dimension scores for lenient/strict/verified_strict in one pass."""
    46→    results: dict[ScoreMode, dict[str, dict]] = {mode: {} for mode in SCORING_MODES}
    47→
    48→    for dim in DIMENSIONS:
    49→        totals = {
    50→            mode: {
    51→                "checks": 0,
    52→                "issues": 0,
    53→                "weighted_failures": 0.0,
    54→                "detectors": {},
    55→            }
    56→            for mode in SCORING_MODES
    57→        }
    58→
    59→        for detector in dim.detectors:
    60→            potential = potentials.get(detector, 0)
    61→            if potential <= 0:
    62→                continue
    63→
    64→            detector_stats = detector_stats_by_mode(detector, findings, potential)
    65→            for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    66→                pass_rate, issues, weighted = detector_stats[mode]
    67→                totals[mode]["checks"] += potential
    68→                totals[mode]["issues"] += issues
    69→                totals[mode]["weighted_failures"] += weighted
    70→                totals[mode]["detectors"][detector] = {
    71→                    "potential": potential,
    72→                    "pass_rate": pass_rate,
    73→                    "issues": issues,
    74→                    "weighted_failures": weighted,
    75→                }
    76→
    77→        for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    78→            total_checks = totals[mode]["checks"]
    79→            if total_checks <= 0:
    80→                continue
    81→            dim_score = (
    82→                max(
    83→                    0.0,
    84→                    (total_checks - totals[mode]["weighted_failures"]) / total_checks,
    85→                )
    86→                * 100
    87→            )
    88→            results[mode][dim.name] = {
    89→                "score": round(dim_score, 1),
    90→                "tier": dim.tier,
    91→                "checks": total_checks,
    92→                "issues": totals[mode]["issues"],
    93→                "detectors": totals[mode]["detectors"],
    94→            }
    95→
    96→    for mode in SCORING_MODES:
    97→        append_subjective_dimensions(
    98→            results[mode],
    99→            findings,

   101→            FAILURE_STATUSES_BY_MODE[mode],

   119→        potentials,

   121→        allowed_subjective_dimensions=allowed_subjective_dimensions,

   123→
   124→

   128→    *,
   129→    subjective_assessments: dict | None = None,
   130→    allowed_subjective_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   131→) -> ScoreBundle:
   132→    """Compute all score channels from one scoring engine pass."""
   133→    by_mode = compute_dimension_scores_by_mode(

   135→        potentials,
   136→        subjective_assessments=subjective_assessments,

   146→        for name, data in lenient_scores.items()
   147→        if "subjective_assessment" not in data.get("detectors", {})
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    return ScoreBundle(
   151→        dimension_scores=lenient_scores,
   152→        strict_dimension_scores=strict_scores,
   153→        verified_strict_dimension_scores=verified_strict_scores,
   154→        overall_score=compute_health_score(lenient_scores),
   155→        objective_score=compute_health_score(mechanical_lenient_scores),

   158→    )

Add `_enforce_workflow_stage_order()` to `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/plan_order.py` and add a triage stage guard to `desloppify/engine/_plan/operations.py`.

## Task 1: plan_order.py

Read `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/plan_order.py` and add:

```python
def _enforce_workflow_stage_order(items: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Re-sort workflow_stage items in-place: unblocked before blocked."""
    stage_entries = [(i, item) for i, item in enumerate(items)
                     if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage"]
    if len(stage_entries) <= 1:
        return
    sorted_stages = sorted(
        [item for _, item in stage_entries],
        key=lambda it: (1 if it.get("is_blocked") else 0, int(it.get("stage_index", 0))),
    )
    for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
        items[idx] = replacement
```

1→"""Stage-gate and coverage helpers for synthesis command handlers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.core.output import colorize
     6→from desloppify.engine.plan import SYNTHESIS_ID
     7→
     8→
     9→def _require_synthesis_pending(plan: dict, *, action: str) -> bool:
    10→    """Require ``synthesis::pending`` to be present in queue for an action."""
    11→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in plan.get("queue_order", []):
    12→        return True
    13→    print(colorize(f"  synthesis::pending is not in the queue — nothing to {action}.", "yellow"))
    14→    return False
    15→
    16→
    17→def _validate_stage_report(
    18→    report: str | None,
    19→    *,
    20→    stage: str,
    21→    min_chars: int,
    22→    missing_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    23→    short_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    24→) -> str | None:
    25→    """Validate staged report presence/length and print consistent guidance."""
    26→    if not report:
    27→        print(colorize(f"  --report is required for --stage {stage}.", "red"))
    28→        for line in missing_guidance or []:
    29→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    30→        return None
    31→    cleaned = report.strip()
    32→    if len(cleaned) < min_chars:
    33→        print(
    34→            colorize(
    35→                f"  Report too short: {len(cleaned)} chars (minimum {min_chars}).",
    36→                "red",
    37→            )
    38→        )
    39→        for line in short_guidance or []:
    40→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    41→        return None
    42→    return cleaned
    43→
    44→
    45→def _synthesis_coverage(plan: dict) -> tuple[int, int, dict]:
    46→    """Return (organized, total, clusters) for synthesis progress."""
    47→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    48→    all_cluster_ids: set[str] = set()
    49→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    50→        all_cluster_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    51→    queue_ids = [finding_id for finding_id in plan.get("queue_order", []) if finding_id != SYNTHESIS_ID]
    52→    organized = sum(1 for finding_id in queue_ids if finding_id in all_cluster_ids)
    53→    return organized, len(queue_ids), clusters
    54→
    55→
    56→def _unenriched_clusters(plan: dict) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    57→    """Return clusters with findings that are missing required enrichment."""
    58→    gaps: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
    59→    for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
    60→        if not cluster.get("finding_ids"):
    61→            continue
    62→        if cluster.get("auto"):
    63→            continue
    64→        missing: list[str] = []
    65→        if not cluster.get("description"):
    66→            missing.append("description")
    67→        if not cluster.get("action_steps"):
    68→            missing.append("action_steps")
    69→        if missing:
    70→            gaps.append((name, missing))
    71→    return gaps
    72→
    73→
    74→def _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan: dict) -> list[str]:
    75→    """Return names of non-auto clusters that have findings."""
    76→    return [
    77→        name
    78→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
    79→        if cluster.get("finding_ids") and not cluster.get("auto")
    80→    ]
    81→

     5→from desloppify.engine.planning.synthesis import review_finding_snapshot_hash
     6→from desloppify.state import utc_now
     7→from desloppify.engine.plan import save_plan
     8→
     9→
    10→def refresh_stage_snapshot(plan: dict, state: dict) -> None:
    11→    """Mark stage progress as aligned with the current review-finding snapshot."""
    12→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    13→    meta["stage_snapshot_hash"] = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
    14→    meta["stage_refresh_required"] = False
    15→
    16→
    17→def record_synthesis_stage(
    18→    plan: dict,
    19→    state: dict,
    20→    *,
    21→    stage: str,
    22→    report: str,
    23→    cited_ids: list[str],
    24→    finding_count: int,
    25→    extra: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    26→) -> dict[str, object]:
    27→    """Persist one stage payload, refresh snapshot metadata, and save the plan."""
    28→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    29→    stages = meta.setdefault("synthesis_stages", {})
    30→    payload: dict[str, object] = {
    31→        "stage": stage,
    32→        "report": report,
    33→        "cited_ids": list(cited_ids),
    34→        "timestamp": utc_now(),
    35→        "finding_count": finding_count,
    36→    }
    37→    if extra:
    38→        payload.update(extra)
    39→    stages[stage] = payload
    40→    refresh_stage_snapshot(plan, state)
    41→    save_plan(plan)
    42→    return payload
    43→

    19→def _normalize_report_text(text: str) -> str:
    20→    return " ".join(str(text).strip().lower().replace("_", " ").split())
    21→
    22→
    23→def _dimension_report_aliases(dimension: str) -> set[str]:
    24→    aliases: set[str] = set()
    25→    canonical = _normalize_report_text(dimension)
    26→    if canonical:
    27→        aliases.add(canonical)
    28→    display_name = DISPLAY_NAMES.get(dimension, "")
    29→    display = _normalize_report_text(display_name)
    30→    if display:
    31→        aliases.add(display)
    32→    return aliases
    33→
    34→
    35→def _report_mentions_dimension(report: str, dimension: str) -> bool:
    36→    normalized_report = _normalize_report_text(report)
    37→    if not normalized_report:
    38→        return False
    39→    padded_report = f" {normalized_report} "
    40→    for alias in _dimension_report_aliases(dimension):
    41→        if alias and f" {alias} " in padded_report:
    42→            return True
    43→        if alias and re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(alias)}\b", normalized_report):
    44→            return True
    45→    return False

1→"""Plan-order and cluster-collapse helpers for work queues."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.state import StateModel
     6→
     7→
     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
     9→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    10→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    11→    if not scan_history:
    12→        return set()
    13→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    14→    if not threshold:
    15→        return set()
    16→    return {
    17→        finding_id
    18→        for finding_id, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    19→        if finding.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
    20→    }
    21→
    22→
    23→def apply_plan_order(
    24→    items: list[dict],
    25→    plan: dict,
    26→    *,
    27→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    28→    cluster: str | None = None,
    29→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
    30→) -> list[dict]:
    31→    """Reorder items according to the living plan."""
    32→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    33→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    34→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    35→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    36→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    37→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    38→
    39→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    40→    for item in items:
    41→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    42→
    43→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    44→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    45→        if override.get("description"):
    46→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    47→        if override.get("note"):
    48→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    49→        if override.get("cluster"):
    50→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    51→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    52→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    53→                "name": cluster_name,
    54→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    55→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    56→            }
    57→
    58→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    59→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    60→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    61→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    62→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    63→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    64→
    65→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
    66→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
    67→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
    68→    _new = new_ids or set()
    69→    for item in items:
    70→        item_id = item["id"]
    71→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
    72→            continue
    73→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
    74→            skipped_items.append(item)
    75→        elif item_id in _new:
    76→            remaining_new.append(item)
    77→        else:
    78→            remaining_existing.append(item)
    79→
    80→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
    81→    if include_skipped:
    82→        result = result + skipped_items
    83→
    84→    for position, item in enumerate(result):
    85→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
    86→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
    87→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
    88→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
    89→            if skip_entry:
    90→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
    91→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
    92→                if skip_reason:
    93→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
    94→
    95→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
    96→    if effective_cluster:
    97→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
    98→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
    99→        if cluster_member_ids:
   100→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   101→    return result
   102→
   103→
   104→def action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   105→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   106→    try:
   107→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   108→
   109→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   110→        if meta:
   111→            return meta.action_type
   112→    except ImportError as exc:
   113→        _ = exc
   114→    return "manual_fix"
   115→
   116→
   117→def _build_cluster_meta(
   118→    cluster_name: str, members: list[dict], cluster_data: dict
   119→) -> dict:
   120→    """Build a cluster meta-item from its member items."""
   121→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   122→    action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   123→    if "desloppify fix" in action:
   124→        action_type = "auto_fix"
   125→    elif "desloppify move" in action:
   126→        action_type = "reorganize"
   127→    else:
   128→        action_type = action_type_for_detector(detector)
   129→        if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   130→            action_type = "refactor"
   131→
   132→    stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   133→    total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   134→    if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   135→        summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   136→    else:
   137→        summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   138→
   139→    primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   140→    if not primary_command:
   141→        primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   142→
   143→    estimated_impact = max(
   144→        (m.get("estimated_impact", 0.0) for m in members), default=0.0
   145→    )
   146→
   147→    return {
   148→        "id": cluster_name,
   149→        "kind": "cluster",
   150→        "action_type": action_type,
   151→        "summary": summary,
   152→        "members": members,
   153→        "member_count": len(members),
   154→        "primary_command": primary_command,
   155→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
   156→        "cluster_auto": True,
   157→        "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   158→        "confidence": "high",
   159→        "detector": detector,
   160→        "file": "",
   161→        "estimated_impact": estimated_impact,
   162→    }
   163→
   164→
   165→def collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   166→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   167→
   168→    Walks the list in order: the first member of each collapsed cluster is
   169→    replaced with its meta-item, subsequent members are skipped.  This
   170→    preserves the ordering established by sort + plan-order.
   171→    """
   172→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   173→    if not clusters:
   174→        return items
   175→
   176→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   177→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   178→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   179→            continue
   180→        for finding_id in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   181→            fid_to_cluster[finding_id] = name
   182→
   183→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   184→        return items
   185→
   186→    # Collect members per cluster (preserving encounter order)
   187→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   188→    for item in items:
   189→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   190→        if cname:
   191→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   192→
   193→    # Build meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members in the queue
   194→    meta_items: dict[str, dict] = {}
   195→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   196→        if len(members) < 2:
   197→            continue
   198→        meta_items[cname] = _build_cluster_meta(
   199→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})
   200→        )
   201→
   202→    # Walk in order: replace first member of each collapsed cluster
   203→    # with its meta-item, skip subsequent members
   204→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   205→    result: list[dict] = []
   206→    for item in items:
   207→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   208→        if cname and cname in meta_items:
   209→            if cname not in seen_clusters:
   210→                seen_clusters.add(cname)
   211→                result.append(meta_items[cname])
   212→            # skip individual member
   213→        else:
   214→            result.append(item)
   215→    return result
   216→
   217→
   218→__all__ = ["apply_plan_order", "collapse_clusters", "new_item_ids"]
   219→

    62→def _remove_id_from_lists(plan: PlanModel, finding_id: str) -> None:

    98→            offset=offset,

   100→        )

   105→def _resolve_relative_position(
   106→    order: list[str],
   107→    moving: set[str],
   108→    *,
   109→    position: str,
   110→    target: str,
   111→) -> int:
   112→    for i, item_id in enumerate(order):
   113→        if item_id == target and item_id not in moving:
   114→            return i if position == "before" else i + 1
   115→    return 0 if position == "before" else len(order)
   116→

   118→def _find_index(items: list[str], target: str) -> int | None:
   119→    for i, item_id in enumerate(items):
   120→        if item_id == target:
   121→            return i
   122→    return None

   125→def _resolve_offset_position(
   126→    order: list[str],
   127→    moving: set[str],
   128→    *,
   129→    position: str,
   130→    offset: int,
   131→    finding_ids: list[str] | None,
   132→) -> int:
   133→    if not finding_ids:
   134→        return 0 if position == "up" else len(order)
   135→    first_id = finding_ids[0]
   136→    clean_order = [x for x in order if x not in moving]
   137→    current_idx = _find_index(clean_order, first_id)
   138→    if current_idx is None:
   139→        if position == "up":
   140→            return max(0, len(clean_order) - offset)
   141→        return len(clean_order)
   142→    if position == "up":
   143→        return max(0, current_idx - offset)
   144→    return min(len(clean_order), current_idx + offset)

   151→def move_items(

   159→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)

   164→    for fid in finding_ids:

   167→    # Remove from current position in order

   232→def unskip_items(

   241→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)

   256→def resurface_stale_skips(
   257→    plan: PlanModel, current_scan_count: int

   259→    """Move temporary skips past their review_after threshold back to queue.
   260→

   263→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   264→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   265→    resurfaced: list[str] = []
   266→    for fid in list(skipped):
   267→        entry = skipped[fid]
   268→        if entry.get("kind") != "temporary":
   269→            continue
   270→        review_after = entry.get("review_after")
   271→        if review_after is None:

   274→        if current_scan_count >= skipped_at + review_after:
   275→            skipped.pop(fid)

   277→                plan["queue_order"].append(fid)

   428→def merge_clusters(
   429→    plan: PlanModel, source_name: str, target_name: str
   430→) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
   431→    """Move all source findings to target, copy missing metadata, delete source.
   432→
   433→    Returns ``(added_count, source_finding_ids)``.
   434→    """
   435→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   436→    if source_name == target_name:
   437→        raise ValueError("Cannot merge a cluster into itself")
   438→    source = plan["clusters"].get(source_name)
   439→    if source is None:
   440→        raise ValueError(f"Source cluster {source_name!r} does not exist")
   441→    target = plan["clusters"].get(target_name)
   442→    if target is None:
   443→        raise ValueError(f"Target cluster {target_name!r} does not exist")
   444→
   445→    source_ids = list(source.get("finding_ids", []))
   446→    target_ids: list[str] = target["finding_ids"]
   447→    now = utc_now()
   448→
   449→    # Add source findings to target (deduplicate)
   450→    existing = set(target_ids)
   451→    added = 0
   452→    for fid in source_ids:
   453→        if fid not in existing:
   454→            target_ids.append(fid)
   455→            existing.add(fid)
   456→            added += 1
   457→        # Update override to point to target cluster
   458→        overrides = plan["overrides"]
   459→        if fid not in overrides:
   460→            overrides[fid] = {"finding_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   461→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = target_name
   462→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   463→
   464→    # Copy metadata from source if target is missing them
   465→    if not target.get("description") and source.get("description"):
   466→        target["description"] = source["description"]
   467→    if not target.get("action_steps") and source.get("action_steps"):
   468→        target["action_steps"] = list(source["action_steps"])
   469→    if not target.get("action") and source.get("action"):
   470→        target["action"] = source["action"]
   471→
   472→    target["updated_at"] = now
   473→
   474→    # Delete source cluster
   475→    plan["clusters"].pop(source_name, None)
   476→    if plan.get("active_cluster") == source_name:
   477→        plan["active_cluster"] = None
   478→
   479→    return added, source_ids

   483→    plan: PlanModel,
   484→    cluster_name: str,
   485→    position: str,
   486→    target: str | None = None,
   487→    offset: int | None = None,
   488→) -> int:
   489→    """Move all cluster members as a contiguous block. Returns count moved."""
   490→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   491→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   492→    if cluster is None:
   493→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   494→
   495→    member_ids = list(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   496→    if not member_ids:

   498→

   526→    created = plan.get("created", utc_now())
   527→    plan.clear()
   528→    for k, v in empty_plan().items():

   533→def purge_ids(plan: PlanModel, finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
   534→    """Remove finding IDs from the plan entirely.
   535→
   536→    Cleans queue_order, skipped, and all cluster memberships.
   537→    Does NOT touch overrides (descriptions/notes are kept for history).
   538→    Returns count of IDs that were actually present somewhere.
   539→    """
   540→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   541→    found = 0
   542→
   543→    purge_set = set(finding_ids)
   544→    promoted: list[str] = plan.get("promoted_ids", [])
   545→    plan["promoted_ids"] = [p for p in promoted if p not in purge_set]
   546→
   547→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   548→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   549→    for fid in finding_ids:
   550→        was_present = False
   551→        if fid in order:
   552→            order.remove(fid)
   553→            was_present = True
   554→        if fid in skipped:
   555→            skipped.pop(fid)
   556→            was_present = True
   557→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   558→            ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   559→            if fid in ids:
   560→                ids.remove(fid)
   561→                was_present = True
   562→        # Clear stale cluster reference from override (preserve notes/descriptions)
   563→        override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(fid)
   564→        if override and override.get("cluster"):
   565→            override["cluster"] = None
   566→            override["updated_at"] = utc_now()
   567→        if was_present:
   568→            found += 1
   569→
   570→    return found

     2→

     4→
     5→import argparse
     6→
     7→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.guardrails import print_synthesis_guardrail_info
     8→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.runtime import command_runtime
     9→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.state import require_completed_scan
    10→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize, print_table
    11→from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_new_finding_ids, load_plan
    12→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    13→
    14→
    15→def _truncate(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    16→    if len(text) <= width:
    17→        return text
    18→    return text[: width - 1] + "\u2026"
    19→
    20→
    21→def _resolve_plan_context(plan: dict, cluster_filter: str | None) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    22→    plan_data: dict | None = None
    23→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
    24→        plan_data = plan
    25→
    26→    effective_cluster = cluster_filter
    27→    if plan_data and not cluster_filter:
    28→        active_cluster = plan_data.get("active_cluster")
    29→        if active_cluster:
    30→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
    31→    return plan_data, effective_cluster
    32→
    33→
    34→def _print_queue_header(
    35→    *,
    36→    items: list[dict],
    37→    include_skipped: bool,
    38→    plan: dict,
    39→    plan_data: dict | None,
    40→    new_count: int = 0,
    41→) -> None:
    42→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
    43→        QueueBreakdown,
    44→        format_queue_headline,
    45→    )
    46→
    47→    total = len(items)
    48→    skipped_count = sum(1 for it in items if it.get("plan_skipped"))
    49→    non_skipped = total - skipped_count
    50→    plan_skipped_total = len(plan.get("skipped", {})) if plan_data else 0
    51→
    52→    # Count subjective items in the visible list
    53→    subjective = sum(
    54→        1 for it in items if it.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension"
    55→    )
    56→
    57→    # Count plan-ordered items (minus skipped)
    58→    plan_ordered = 0
    59→    if plan_data:
    60→        queue_order = plan_data.get("queue_order", [])
    61→        skipped_ids = set(plan_data.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    62→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    63→
    64→    breakdown = QueueBreakdown(
    65→        queue_total=non_skipped,
    66→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
    67→        skipped=plan_skipped_total,
    68→        subjective=subjective,
    69→    )
    70→    headline = format_queue_headline(breakdown)
    71→    new_suffix = f"  ({new_count} new this scan)" if new_count > 0 else ""
    72→    print(colorize(f"\n  {headline}{new_suffix}", "bold"))
    73→
    74→    focus = plan.get("active_cluster") if plan_data else None
    75→    if focus:
    76→        print(colorize(f"  Focus: {focus}", "cyan"))
    77→
    78→    if include_skipped or skipped_count != 0:
    79→        return
    80→    if not plan_skipped_total:
    81→        return
    82→    print(
    83→        colorize(
    84→            f"  ({plan_skipped_total} skipped item{'s' if plan_skipped_total != 1 else ''}"
    85→            " hidden — use --include-skipped)",
    86→            "dim",
    87→        )
    88→    )
    89→
    90→
    91→def _queue_display_items(items: list[dict], *, top: int) -> list[dict]:
    92→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
    93→        return items[:top]
    94→    return items
    95→
    96→
    97→def _build_rows(display_items: list[dict], new_ids: set[str] | None = None) -> list[list[str]]:
    98→    rows: list[list[str]] = []
    99→    _new = new_ids or set()
   100→    for idx, item in enumerate(display_items, 1):
   101→        pos = str(idx)
   102→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   103→
   104→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   105→            blocked = item.get("is_blocked", False)
   106→            blocked_tag = " [blocked]" if blocked else ""
   107→            conf_str = "—"
   108→            detector = "planning"
   109→            summary = f"{item.get('summary', '')}{blocked_tag}"
   110→            cluster_name = ""
   111→        elif kind == "workflow_action":
   112→            conf_str = "—"
   113→            detector = "workflow"
   114→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   115→            cluster_name = ""
   116→        elif kind == "cluster":
   117→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "high")
   118→            member_count = item.get("member_count", 0)
   119→            detector = item.get("detector", "cluster")
   120→            new_in_cluster = sum(
   121→                1 for m in item.get("members", [])
   122→                if m.get("id") in _new
   123→            )
   124→            new_tag = f" (+{new_in_cluster} new)" if new_in_cluster else ""
   125→            summary = f"[{member_count} items{new_tag}] {item.get('summary', '')}"
   126→            cluster_name = item.get("cluster_name", item.get("id", ""))
   127→        else:
   128→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   129→            detector = item.get("detector", "")
   130→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   131→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   132→            cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "") if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else ""
   133→
   134→        prefix = "* " if item.get("id") in _new else ""
   135→        suffix = " [skip]" if item.get("plan_skipped") else ""
   136→        summary_display = _truncate(prefix + summary, 48) + suffix
   137→        rows.append([pos, conf_str, detector, summary_display, cluster_name])
   138→    return rows
   139→
   140→
   141→def cmd_plan_queue(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   142→    """Render a compact table of all upcoming queue items."""
   143→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   144→    state = runtime.state
   145→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   146→        return
   147→
   148→    top = getattr(args, "top", 30)
   149→    cluster_filter = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   150→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   151→
   152→    plan = load_plan()
   153→    print_synthesis_guardrail_info(plan=plan, state=state)
   154→    plan_data, effective_cluster = _resolve_plan_context(plan, cluster_filter)
   155→
   156→    queue = build_work_queue(
   157→        state,
   158→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   159→            count=None,
   160→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   161→            status="open",
   162→            include_subjective=True,
   163→            plan=plan_data,
   164→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   165→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   166→            collapse_clusters=True,
   167→        ),
   168→    )
   169→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   170→
   171→    sort_by = getattr(args, "sort", "priority")
   172→    all_new_ids: set[str] = queue.get("new_ids", set())
   173→    # Merge review-based new finding IDs (since last synthesis)
   174→    review_new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(plan, state)
   175→    all_new_ids = all_new_ids | review_new_ids
   176→    item_ids = {it.get("id") for it in items}
   177→    new_ids = all_new_ids & item_ids
   178→
   179→    if sort_by == "recent":
   180→        items = sorted(items, key=lambda it: it.get("first_seen", ""), reverse=True)
   181→
   182→    _print_queue_header(
   183→        items=items,
   184→        include_skipped=include_skipped,
   185→        plan=plan,
   186→        plan_data=plan_data,
   187→        new_count=len(new_ids),
   188→    )
   189→
   190→    if not items:
   191→        print(colorize("\n  Queue is empty.", "green"))
   192→        return
   193→
   194→    # Determine which items to show
   195→    display_items = _queue_display_items(items, top=top)
   196→    headers = ["#", "Confidence", "Detector", "Summary", "Cluster"]
   197→    rows = _build_rows(display_items, new_ids=new_ids)
   198→
   199→    print()
   200→    widths = [4, 4, 12, 50, 16]
   201→    print_table(headers, rows, widths=widths)
   202→
   203→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
   204→        remaining = len(items) - top
   205→        print(colorize(
   206→            f"\n  ... and {remaining} more (use --top 0 to show all)", "dim"
   207→        ))
   208→    print()
   209→
   210→
   211→__all__ = ["cmd_plan_queue"]
   212→

   264→    g_batch.add_argument(

   433→def _fixer_help_lines(langs: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   434→    fixer_help_lines: list[str] = []
   435→    for lang_name in langs:
   436→        try:
   437→            fixer_names = sorted(get_lang(lang_name).fixers.keys())
   438→        except (ImportError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   439→            fixer_names = []
   440→        fixer_list = ", ".join(fixer_names) if fixer_names else "none yet"
   441→        fixer_help_lines.append(f"fixers ({lang_name}): {fixer_list}")
   442→    fixer_help_lines.append("special: review — prepare structured review data")
   443→    return fixer_help_lines
   444→
   445→
   446→def _add_fix_parser(sub, langs: list[str]) -> None:
   447→    p_fix = sub.add_parser(
   448→        "fix",

   450→        epilog="\n".join(_fixer_help_lines(langs)),
   451→    )
   452→    p_fix.add_argument("fixer", type=str, help="What to fix")
   453→    p_fix.add_argument("--path", type=str, default=None, help="Project root directory (default: auto-detected)")
   454→    p_fix.add_argument("--state", type=str, default=None, help="Path to state file")
   455→    p_fix.add_argument(
   456→        "--dry-run",
   457→        action="store_true",
   458→        help="Show what would change without modifying files",
   459→    )

   462→def _add_plan_parser(sub) -> None:
   463→    p_plan = sub.add_parser(
   464→        "plan",
   465→        help="Living plan: generate, reorder, cluster, skip, note",
   466→        description="""\
   467→Manage the living plan — a persistent layer on top of the work queue.
   468→Track custom ordering, clusters, skips, and per-finding annotations.
   469→Run with no subcommand to generate a full prioritized markdown plan.""",
   470→        epilog="""\
   471→typical workflow:
   472→  desloppify scan                       # detect findings
   473→  desloppify plan                       # full prioritized markdown
   474→  desloppify plan queue                 # compact table of all items
   475→  desloppify plan cluster create ...    # group related findings
   476→  desloppify plan focus <cluster>       # narrow scope
   477→  desloppify next                       # work on the next item
   478→  desloppify plan done <id> --attest .. # mark as fixed
   479→
   480→patterns (used by move, skip, done, describe, note, etc.):
   481→  Patterns match findings by detector, file, ID prefix, glob, or name.
   482→  Cluster names also work as patterns — they expand to all member IDs.
   483→  Examples: "security", "src/foo.py", "unused::*React*", "my-cluster"
   484→
   485→subcommands:
   486→  show       Show plan metadata summary
   487→  queue      Compact table of upcoming queue items
   488→  reset      Reset plan to empty
   489→  move       Move findings or clusters in the queue
   490→  done       Mark findings as fixed (score movement + next-step)
   491→  describe   Set augmented description
   492→  note       Set note on findings
   493→  skip       Skip findings (temporary/permanent/false_positive)
   494→  unskip     Bring skipped findings back to queue
   495→  reopen     Reopen resolved findings
   496→  focus      Set or clear active cluster focus
   497→  cluster    Manage finding clusters
   498→  synthesize Staged synthesis workflow (after review)""",
   499→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
   500→    )
   501→    p_plan.add_argument("--state", type=str, default=None, help="Path to state file")
   502→    p_plan.add_argument(
   503→        "--output", type=str, metavar="FILE", help="Write to file instead of stdout"
   504→    )
   505→
   506→    plan_sub = p_plan.add_subparsers(dest="plan_action")
   507→
   508→    # plan show
   509→    plan_sub.add_parser("show", help="Show plan metadata summary")
   510→
   511→    # plan queue
   512→    p_queue = plan_sub.add_parser("queue", help="Compact table of upcoming queue items")
   513→    p_queue.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=30, help="Max items (default: 30, 0=all)")
   514→    p_queue.add_argument("--cluster", type=str, default=None, metavar="NAME",
   515→                         help="Filter to a specific cluster")
   516→    p_queue.add_argument("--include-skipped", action="store_true",
   517→                         help="Include skipped items at end")
   518→    p_queue.add_argument("--sort", choices=["priority", "recent"], default="priority",
   519→                         help="Sort order (default: priority)")
   520→
   521→    # plan reset
   522→    plan_sub.add_parser("reset", help="Reset plan to empty")
   523→
   524→    # plan move <patterns> <position> [--target TARGET]
   525→    p_move = plan_sub.add_parser(
   526→        "move",
   527→        help="Move findings in the queue",
   528→        epilog="""\
   529→patterns accept finding IDs, detector names, file paths, globs, or cluster names.
   530→cluster names expand to all member IDs automatically.
   531→
   532→examples:
   533→  desloppify plan move security top                         # all findings from detector
   534→  desloppify plan move "unused::src/foo.ts::*" top          # glob pattern
   535→  desloppify plan move smells bottom                        # deprioritize
   536→  desloppify plan move my-cluster top                       # cluster members
   537→  desloppify plan move my-cluster unused top                # mix clusters + findings
   538→  desloppify plan move unused before -t security            # before a finding/cluster
   539→  desloppify plan move smells after -t my-cluster           # after a cluster
   540→  desloppify plan move security up -t 3                     # shift up 3 positions""",
   541→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
   542→    )
   543→    p_move.add_argument(
   544→        "patterns", nargs="+", metavar="PATTERN",
   545→        help="Finding ID(s), detector, file path, glob, or cluster name",
   546→    )
   547→    p_move.add_argument(
   548→        "position", choices=["top", "bottom", "before", "after", "up", "down"],
   549→        help="Where to move",
   550→    )
   551→    p_move.add_argument(
   552→        "-t", "--target", default=None,
   553→        help="Required for before/after (finding ID or cluster name) and up/down (integer offset)",
   554→    )
   555→
   556→    # plan describe <patterns> "<text>"
   557→    p_describe = plan_sub.add_parser("describe", help="Set augmented description")
   558→    p_describe.add_argument(
   559→        "patterns", nargs="+", metavar="PATTERN",
   560→        help="Finding ID(s), detector, file path, glob, or cluster name",
   561→    )
   562→    p_describe.add_argument("text", type=str, help="Description text")
   563→
   564→    # plan note <patterns> "<text>"
   565→    p_note = plan_sub.add_parser("note", help="Set note on findings")
   566→    p_note.add_argument(
   567→        "patterns", nargs="+", metavar="PATTERN",
   568→        help="Finding ID(s), detector, file path, glob, or cluster name",
   569→    )
   570→    p_note.add_argument("text", type=str, help="Note text")
   571→
   572→    # plan skip <patterns> [--reason] [--review-after N] [--permanent] [--false-positive] [--note] [--attest]
   573→    p_skip = plan_sub.add_parser(
   574→        "skip",

   577→    p_skip.add_argument(

   595→    p_skip.add_argument(

   599→
   600→    # plan unskip <patterns>
   601→    p_unskip = plan_sub.add_parser(
   602→        "unskip", help="Bring skipped findings back to queue (reopens permanent/fp in state)"

   604→    p_unskip.add_argument(

   608→
   609→    # plan reopen <patterns>
   610→    p_reopen = plan_sub.add_parser(
   611→        "reopen", help="Reopen resolved findings and move back to queue"
   612→    )
   613→    p_reopen.add_argument(
   614→        "patterns", nargs="+", metavar="PATTERN",
   615→        help="Finding ID(s), detector, file path, glob, or cluster name",
   616→    )
   617→
   618→    # plan done <patterns> --attest [--note]
   619→    p_done = plan_sub.add_parser(
   620→        "done",
   621→        help="Mark findings as fixed (shows score movement + next step)",
   622→        epilog="""\
   623→examples:
   624→  desloppify plan done "unused::src/foo.tsx::React" \\
   625→    --attest "I have actually removed the import and I am not gaming the score."
   626→  desloppify plan done security --note "patched XSS" \\
   627→    --attest "I have actually ..."  """,
   628→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,

   630→    p_done.add_argument(
   631→        "patterns", nargs="+", metavar="PATTERN",

   634→    p_done.add_argument(
   635→        "--note", type=str, default=None, help="Explanation of the fix"

   637→    p_done.add_argument(
   638→        "--attest",
   639→        type=str,

   646→    p_done.add_argument(

   652→    p_done.add_argument(

   660→    # plan focus <cluster> | --clear
   661→    p_focus = plan_sub.add_parser("focus", help="Set or clear active cluster focus")
