    15→def _truncate(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    16→    if len(text) <= width:
    17→        return text
    18→    return text[: width - 1] + "\u2026"
    19→
    20→
    21→def _resolve_plan_context(plan: dict, cluster_filter: str | None) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    22→    plan_data: dict | None = None
    23→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
    24→        plan_data = plan
    25→
    26→    effective_cluster = cluster_filter
    27→    if plan_data and not cluster_filter:
    28→        active_cluster = plan_data.get("active_cluster")
    29→        if active_cluster:
    30→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
    31→    return plan_data, effective_cluster
    32→
    33→
    34→def _print_queue_header(
    35→    *,
    36→    items: list[dict],
    37→    include_skipped: bool,
    38→    plan: dict,
    39→    plan_data: dict | None,
    40→    new_count: int = 0,
    41→) -> None:
    42→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
    43→        QueueBreakdown,
    44→        format_queue_headline,
    45→    )
    46→
    47→    total = len(items)
    48→    skipped_count = sum(1 for it in items if it.get("plan_skipped"))
    49→    non_skipped = total - skipped_count
    50→    plan_skipped_total = len(plan.get("skipped", {})) if plan_data else 0
    51→
    52→    # Count subjective items in the visible list
    53→    subjective = sum(
    54→        1 for it in items if it.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension"
    55→    )
    56→
    57→    # Count plan-ordered items (minus skipped)
    58→    plan_ordered = 0
    59→    if plan_data:
    60→        queue_order = plan_data.get("queue_order", [])
    61→        skipped_ids = set(plan_data.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    62→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    63→
    64→    breakdown = QueueBreakdown(
    65→        queue_total=non_skipped,
    66→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
    67→        skipped=plan_skipped_total,
    68→        subjective=subjective,
    69→    )
    70→    headline = format_queue_headline(breakdown)
    71→    new_suffix = f"  ({new_count} new this scan)" if new_count > 0 else ""
    72→    print(colorize(f"\n  {headline}{new_suffix}", "bold"))
    73→
    74→    focus = plan.get("active_cluster") if plan_data else None
    75→    if focus:
    76→        print(colorize(f"  Focus: {focus}", "cyan"))
    77→
    78→    if include_skipped or skipped_count != 0:
    79→        return
    80→    if not plan_skipped_total:
    81→        return
    82→    print(
    83→        colorize(
    84→            f"  ({plan_skipped_total} skipped item{'s' if plan_skipped_total != 1 else ''}"
    85→            " hidden — use --include-skipped)",
    86→            "dim",
    87→        )
    88→    )
    89→
    90→
    91→def _queue_display_items(items: list[dict], *, top: int) -> list[dict]:
    92→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
    93→        return items[:top]
    94→    return items
    95→
    96→
    97→def _build_rows(display_items: list[dict], new_ids: set[str] | None = None) -> list[list[str]]:
    98→    rows: list[list[str]] = []
    99→    _new = new_ids or set()
   100→    for idx, item in enumerate(display_items, 1):
   101→        pos = str(idx)
   102→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   103→
   104→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   105→            blocked = item.get("is_blocked", False)
   106→            blocked_tag = " [blocked]" if blocked else ""
   107→            conf_str = "—"
   108→            detector = "planning"
   109→            summary = f"{item.get('summary', '')}{blocked_tag}"
   110→            cluster_name = ""
   111→        elif kind == "workflow_action":
   112→            conf_str = "—"
   113→            detector = "workflow"
   114→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   115→            cluster_name = ""
   116→        elif kind == "cluster":
   117→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "high")
   118→            member_count = item.get("member_count", 0)
   119→            detector = item.get("detector", "cluster")
   120→            new_in_cluster = sum(
   121→                1 for m in item.get("members", [])
   122→                if m.get("id") in _new
   123→            )
   124→            new_tag = f" (+{new_in_cluster} new)" if new_in_cluster else ""
   125→            summary = f"[{member_count} items{new_tag}] {item.get('summary', '')}"
   126→            cluster_name = item.get("cluster_name", item.get("id", ""))
   127→        else:
   128→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   129→            detector = item.get("detector", "")
   130→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   131→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   132→            cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "") if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else ""
   133→
   134→        prefix = "* " if item.get("id") in _new else ""
   135→        suffix = " [skip]" if item.get("plan_skipped") else ""
   136→        summary_display = _truncate(prefix + summary, 48) + suffix
   137→        rows.append([pos, conf_str, detector, summary_display, cluster_name])
   138→    return rows
   139→
   140→
   141→def cmd_plan_queue(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   142→    """Render a compact table of all upcoming queue items."""
   143→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   144→    state = runtime.state
   145→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   146→        return
   147→
   148→    top = getattr(args, "top", 30)
   149→    cluster_filter = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   150→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   151→
   152→    plan = load_plan()
   153→    print_synthesis_guardrail_info(plan=plan, state=state)
   154→    plan_data, effective_cluster = _resolve_plan_context(plan, cluster_filter)
   155→
   156→    queue = build_work_queue(
   157→        state,
   158→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   159→            count=None,
   160→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   161→            status="open",
   162→            include_subjective=True,
   163→            plan=plan_data,
   164→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   165→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   166→            collapse_clusters=True,
   167→        ),
   168→    )
   169→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   170→
   171→    sort_by = getattr(args, "sort", "priority")
   172→    all_new_ids: set[str] = queue.get("new_ids", set())
   173→    # Merge review-based new finding IDs (since last synthesis)
   174→    review_new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(plan, state)
   175→    all_new_ids = all_new_ids | review_new_ids
   176→    item_ids = {it.get("id") for it in items}
   177→    new_ids = all_new_ids & item_ids
   178→
   179→    if sort_by == "recent":
   180→        items = sorted(items, key=lambda it: it.get("first_seen", ""), reverse=True)
   181→
   182→    _print_queue_header(
   183→        items=items,
   184→        include_skipped=include_skipped,
   185→        plan=plan,
   186→        plan_data=plan_data,
   187→        new_count=len(new_ids),
   188→    )
   189→
   190→    if not items:
   191→        print(colorize("\n  Queue is empty.", "green"))
   192→        return
   193→
   194→    # Determine which items to show
   195→    display_items = _queue_display_items(items, top=top)
   196→    headers = ["#", "Confidence", "Detector", "Summary", "Cluster"]
   197→    rows = _build_rows(display_items, new_ids=new_ids)
   198→
   199→    print()
   200→    widths = [4, 4, 12, 50, 16]
   201→    print_table(headers, rows, widths=widths)
   202→
   203→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
   204→        remaining = len(items) - top
   205→        print(colorize(
   206→            f"\n  ... and {remaining} more (use --top 0 to show all)", "dim"
   207→        ))
   208→    print()
   209→
   210→
   211→__all__ = ["cmd_plan_queue"]

    46→def _plan_file_for_state(state_file: Path | None) -> Path | None:

    52→def _snapshot_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
    53→    if not path.exists():
    54→        return None
    55→    return path.read_text()
    56→
    57→
    58→def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:
    59→    if snapshot is None:
    60→        try:
    61→            path.unlink()
    62→        except FileNotFoundError:
    63→            return
    64→        return
    65→    safe_write_text(path, snapshot)

    68→def _save_plan_state_transactional(
    69→    *,
    70→    plan: dict,
    71→    plan_path: Path | None,
    72→    state_data: dict,
    73→    state_path_value: Path | None,
    74→) -> None:
    75→    """Persist plan+state together; rollback both files on partial write failure."""
    76→    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)
    77→    effective_state_path = _resolve_state_file(state_path_value)
    78→    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)
    79→    state_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_state_path)
    80→
    81→    try:
    82→        state_mod.save_state(state_data, effective_state_path)
    83→        save_plan(plan, effective_plan_path)
    84→    except Exception:
    85→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_state_path, state_snapshot)
    86→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_plan_path, plan_snapshot)

   144→def cmd_plan_skip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   145→    """Skip findings — unified command for temporary/permanent/false-positive."""
   146→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   147→    state = runtime.state
   148→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   149→        return
   150→
   151→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   152→    reason: str | None = getattr(args, "reason", None)
   153→    review_after: int | None = getattr(args, "review_after", None)
   154→    permanent: bool = getattr(args, "permanent", False)
   155→    false_positive: bool = getattr(args, "false_positive", False)
   156→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   157→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   158→
   159→    # Determine skip kind
   160→    if false_positive:
   161→        kind = "false_positive"
   162→    elif permanent:
   163→        kind = "permanent"
   164→    else:
   165→        kind = "temporary"
   166→
   167→    # Validate requirements for permanent/false_positive
   168→    if kind in ("permanent", "false_positive"):
   169→        if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   170→            show_attestation_requirement(
   171→                "Permanent skip" if kind == "permanent" else "False positive",
   172→                attestation,
   173→                ATTEST_EXAMPLE,
   174→            )
   175→            return
   176→        if kind == "permanent" and not note:
   177→            print(
   178→                colorize("  --permanent requires --note to explain the decision.", "yellow"),
   179→                file=sys.stderr,
   180→            )
   181→            return
   182→
   183→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   184→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   185→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   186→    finding_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
   187→    if not finding_ids:
   188→        print(colorize("  No matching findings found.", "yellow"))
   189→        return
   190→
   191→    # For permanent/false_positive: delegate to state layer for score impact
   192→    state_data: dict | None = None
   193→    if kind in ("permanent", "false_positive"):
   194→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   195→        status = "wontfix" if kind == "permanent" else "false_positive"
   196→        for fid in finding_ids:
   197→            state_mod.resolve_findings(
   198→                state_data, fid, status, note or "", attestation=attestation
   199→            )
   200→
   201→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   202→    count = skip_items(
   203→        plan,
   204→        finding_ids,

   206→        reason=reason,
   207→        note=note,
   208→        attestation=attestation,
   209→        review_after=review_after,
   210→        scan_count=scan_count,
   211→    )
   212→
   213→    # Log the skip action

   215→        plan,
   216→        "skip",
   217→        finding_ids=finding_ids,
   218→        actor="user",
   219→        note=note,
   220→        detail={"kind": kind, "reason": reason},
   221→    )
   222→    if state_data is not None:
   223→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   224→            plan=plan,
   225→            plan_path=plan_file,
   226→            state_data=state_data,
   227→            state_path_value=state_file,
   228→        )
   229→    else:
   230→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   231→
   232→    label = {"temporary": "Skipped", "permanent": "Wontfixed", "false_positive": "Marked false positive"}
   233→    print(colorize(f"  {label[kind]} {count} item(s).", "green"))
   234→    if review_after:
   235→        print(colorize(f"  Will re-surface after {review_after} scan(s).", "dim"))

   238→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   239→    """Unskip findings — bring back to queue."""
   240→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   241→    state = runtime.state
   242→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   243→        return
   244→
   245→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   246→
   247→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   248→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   249→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   250→    # For unskip we need to match against all statuses (skipped items may be wontfix/fp)
   251→    finding_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   252→    if not finding_ids:
   253→        print(colorize("  No matching findings found.", "yellow"))
   254→        return
   255→
   256→    count, need_reopen = unskip_items(plan, finding_ids)
   257→    append_log_entry(
   258→        plan, "unskip", finding_ids=finding_ids, actor="user",
   259→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   260→    )
   261→
   262→    # Reopen permanent/false_positive items in state
   263→    reopened: list[str] = []
   264→    if need_reopen:
   265→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   266→        for fid in need_reopen:
   267→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_findings(state_data, fid, "open"))
   268→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   269→            plan=plan,
   270→            plan_path=plan_file,
   271→            state_data=state_data,
   272→            state_path_value=state_file,
   273→        )
   274→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} finding(s) in state.", "dim"))
   275→    else:
   276→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   277→
   278→    print(colorize(f"  Unskipped {count} item(s) — back in queue.", "green"))
   279→
   280→
   281→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   282→# Reopen
   283→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   284→
   285→def cmd_plan_reopen(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   286→    """Reopen resolved findings from plan context."""
   287→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   288→
   289→    raw_state_path = state_path(args)
   290→    state_file = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, Path) else Path(raw_state_path) if raw_state_path else None
   291→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   292→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   293→
   294→    reopened: list[str] = []
   295→    for pattern in patterns:
   296→        reopened.extend(
   297→            state_mod.resolve_findings(state_data, pattern, "open")
   298→        )
   299→
   300→    if not reopened:
   301→        print(colorize("  No resolved findings matching: " + " ".join(patterns), "yellow"))
   302→        return
   303→
   304→    # Remove from skipped if present, and ensure all reopened IDs are in queue
   305→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   306→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   307→    count = 0
   308→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   309→    for fid in reopened:
   310→        if fid in skipped:
   311→            skipped.pop(fid)
   312→            count += 1
   313→        if fid not in order:
   314→            plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   315→            order.add(fid)
   316→            count += 1
   317→    append_log_entry(
   318→        plan, "reopen", finding_ids=reopened, actor="user",
   319→    )
   320→    _save_plan_state_transactional(
   321→        plan=plan,
   322→        plan_path=plan_file,
   323→        state_data=state_data,
   324→        state_path_value=state_file,
   325→    )
   326→
   327→    print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} finding(s).", "green"))
   328→    if count:
   329→        print(colorize(f"  Plan updated: items moved back to queue.", "dim"))
   330→
   331→
   332→_CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD = 10
   333→
   334→
   335→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   336→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   337→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   338→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   339→    for pattern in patterns:
   340→        if pattern in clusters:
   341→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   342→            # Filter to alive findings only — stale IDs should not count
   343→            ids = [
   344→                fid for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   345→                if fid in findings and findings[fid].get("status") == "open"
   346→            ]
   347→            if len(ids) == 0:
   348→                print(colorize(
   349→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   350→                    "yellow",
   351→                ))
   352→                print(colorize(
   353→                    f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <finding-id>",
   354→                    "dim",
   355→                ))
   356→                return True  # blocked
   357→            if len(ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
   358→                _print_cluster_guard(pattern, ids, state)
   359→                return True  # blocked
   360→    return False  # OK
   361→
   362→
   363→def _print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
   364→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   365→    print(colorize(
   366→        f"\n  Cluster '{cluster_name}' has {len(finding_ids)} item(s) — mark them done individually first:\n",
   367→        "yellow",
   368→    ))
   369→    for fid in finding_ids:
   370→        f = findings.get(fid, {})
   371→        summary = f.get("summary", "(no summary)")[:80]
   372→        detector = f.get("detector", "?")
   373→        print(f"    {fid}  [{detector}]  {summary}")
   374→    print(colorize(
   375→        f"\n  Use: desloppify resolve <id> --status fixed --note '...' --attest '...'",
   376→        "dim",
   377→    ))
   378→    print(colorize(
   379→        f"  Or mark each done: desloppify plan done <id> --note '...' --confirm\n",
   380→        "dim",
   381→    ))

   383→
   384→def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
   385→    """Return True if the ID is a synthetic workflow/synthesis item, not a real finding."""
   386→    return fid.startswith("synthesis::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")
   387→
   388→
   389→def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   390→    """Separate synthetic IDs from real finding patterns.
   391→
   392→    Returns (synthetic_ids, remaining_patterns).
   393→    """
   394→    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   395→    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   396→    return synthetic, remaining
   397→
   398→
   399→def _blocked_synthesis_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   400→    """Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for synthesis stages that can't run yet.
   401→
   402→    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —
   403→    no state needed, no queue item construction.
   404→    """
   405→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.synthesis_playbook import SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES
   406→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SYNTHESIS_IDS, SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS
   407→
   408→    order_set = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   409→    present = order_set & SYNTHESIS_IDS
   410→    if not present:
   411→        return {}
   412→
   413→    confirmed = set(plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {}).get("synthesis_stages", {}).keys())
   414→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   415→
   416→    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   417→    for sid, name in zip(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   418→        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:
   419→            continue
   420→        deps = SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   421→        unmet = sorted(
   422→            f"synthesis::{dep}" for dep in deps
   423→            if f"synthesis::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   424→        )
   425→        if unmet:
   426→            blocked[sid] = unmet
   427→    return blocked
   428→
   429→
   430→def cmd_plan_done(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   431→    """Mark findings as fixed — delegates to cmd_resolve for rich UX."""
   432→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   433→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   434→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   435→
   436→    # --confirm: auto-generate attestation from --note
   437→    if getattr(args, "confirm", False):
   438→        if not note:
   439→            print(colorize("  --confirm requires --note to describe what you did.", "red"))
   440→            return
   441→        attestation = f"I have actually {note} and I am not gaming the score."
   442→        args.attest = attestation
   443→
   444→    # Handle synthetic IDs (synthesis::*, workflow::*, subjective::*) directly
   445→    synthetic_ids, real_patterns = _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns)
   446→    if synthetic_ids:
   447→        plan = load_plan()
   448→        # Validate synthesis dependency chain
   449→        blocked_map = _blocked_synthesis_stages(plan)
   450→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   451→            if sid in blocked_map:
   452→                deps = ", ".join(b.replace("synthesis::", "") for b in blocked_map[sid])
   453→                print(colorize(f"  Cannot resolve {sid} — blocked by: {deps}", "red"))
   454→                print(colorize("  Complete those stages first, or use --force-resolve to override.", "dim"))
   455→                if not getattr(args, "force_resolve", False):
   456→                    return
   457→        purge_ids(plan, synthetic_ids)
   458→        append_log_entry(
   459→            plan, "done", finding_ids=synthetic_ids, actor="user", note=note,
   460→        )
   461→        save_plan(plan)
   462→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   463→            print(colorize(f"  Resolved: {sid}", "green"))
   464→        if not real_patterns:
   465→            return
   466→        # Continue with remaining real patterns
   467→        patterns = real_patterns
   468→        args.patterns = patterns
   469→
   470→    # Validate note length
   471→    if not validate_note_length(note):
   472→        show_note_length_requirement(note)
   473→        return
   474→
   475→    # Pre-validate attestation before delegating (avoids stale hint in resolve)
   476→    if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   477→        show_attestation_requirement("Plan done", attestation, ATTEST_EXAMPLE)
   478→        return
   479→
   480→    # Cluster completion guard: block bulk-completing small clusters
   481→    try:
   482→        runtime = command_runtime(args)
   483→        state = runtime.state
   484→        plan = load_plan()
   485→        if _check_cluster_guard(patterns, plan, state):
   486→            return
   487→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   488→        plan = None
   489→
   490→    # Log the done action (best-effort)
   491→    try:
   492→        if plan is None:
   493→            plan = load_plan()
   494→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   495→        cluster_name = None
   496→        for p in patterns:
   497→            if p in clusters:
   498→                cluster_name = p
   499→                break
   500→        append_log_entry(
   501→            plan,
   502→            "done",
   503→            finding_ids=patterns,
   504→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   505→            actor="user",
   506→            note=note,
   507→        )
   508→        save_plan(plan)
   509→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
   510→        print(colorize(f"  Note: unable to append plan done log entry ({exc}).", "dim"))
   511→
   512→    # Deferred import: cmd_resolve has a heavy import chain that isn't needed
   513→    # for synthetic-ID handling above.
   514→    from desloppify.app.commands.resolve.cmd import cmd_resolve
   515→
   516→    # Build a Namespace that cmd_resolve expects
   517→    resolve_args = argparse.Namespace(
   518→        status="fixed",
   519→        patterns=patterns,
   520→        note=note,
   521→        attest=attestation,
   522→        confirm_batch_wontfix=False,
   523→        force_resolve=bool(getattr(args, "force_resolve", False)),
   524→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
   525→        lang=getattr(args, "lang", None),
   526→        path=getattr(args, "path", None),
   527→        exclude=getattr(args, "exclude", None),
   528→    )
   529→
   530→    cmd_resolve(resolve_args)

    19→@dataclass
    20→class SynthesisGuardrailResult:
    21→    """Structured result from synthesis staleness detection."""
    22→
    23→    is_stale: bool = False
    24→    new_ids: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    25→    _plan: dict | None = field(default=None, repr=False)

    27→
    28→def synthesis_guardrail_status(
    29→    *,
    30→    plan: dict | None = None,
    31→    state: dict | None = None,
    32→) -> SynthesisGuardrailResult:
    33→    """Pure detection: is synthesis stale? Returns structured result, no side effects."""
    34→    try:
    35→        resolved_plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else load_plan()
    36→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    37→        return SynthesisGuardrailResult()
    38→
    39→    resolved_state = state or {}
    40→
    41→    if not is_synthesis_stale(resolved_plan, resolved_state):
    42→        return SynthesisGuardrailResult(_plan=resolved_plan)
    43→
    44→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
    45→    if resolved_state:
    46→        new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(resolved_plan, resolved_state)
    47→
    48→    return SynthesisGuardrailResult(is_stale=True, new_ids=new_ids, _plan=resolved_plan)
    49→

    51→def print_synthesis_guardrail_info(
    52→    *,

    57→    result = synthesis_guardrail_status(plan=plan, state=state)

    72→    return True

   114→        "dim",

    83→        print(colorize(f"  {config_warning}", "yellow"))
    84→
    85→    print_synthesis_guardrail_info(state=state)
    86→    _get_items(args, state, config)

    88→
    89→def _resolve_cluster_focus(
    90→    plan_data: dict | None,
    91→    *,
    92→    cluster_arg: str | None,
    93→    scope: str | None,
    94→) -> str | None:
    95→    effective_cluster = cluster_arg
    96→    if plan_data and not cluster_arg and not scope:
    97→        active_cluster = plan_data.get("active_cluster")
    98→        if active_cluster:
    99→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
   100→    return effective_cluster
   101→
   102→
   103→def _build_next_payload(
   104→    *,
   105→    queue: dict,
   106→    items: list[dict],
   107→    state: dict,
   108→    narrative: dict,
   109→    plan_data: dict | None,
   110→) -> dict:
   111→    payload = next_output_mod.build_query_payload(
   112→        queue, items, command="next", narrative=narrative, plan=plan_data
   113→    )
   114→    payload["overall_score"] = state_mod.get_overall_score(state)
   115→    payload["objective_score"] = state_mod.get_objective_score(state)
   116→    payload["strict_score"] = state_mod.get_strict_score(state)
   117→    payload["scorecard_dimensions"] = scorecard_dimensions_payload(
   118→        state,
   119→        dim_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   120→    )
   121→    payload["subjective_measures"] = [
   122→        row for row in payload["scorecard_dimensions"] if row.get("subjective")
   123→    ]
   124→    return payload
   125→
   126→
   127→def _emit_requested_output(
   128→    args,
   129→    payload: dict,
   130→    items: list[dict],
   131→) -> bool:
   132→    output_file = getattr(args, "output", None)
   133→    if output_file:
   134→        if next_output_mod.write_output_file(
   135→            output_file,
   136→            payload,
   137→            len(items),
   138→            safe_write_text_fn=safe_write_text,
   139→            colorize_fn=colorize,
   140→        ):
   141→            return True
   142→        raise SystemExit(1)
   143→
   144→    output_format = getattr(args, "format", "terminal")
   145→    if next_output_mod.emit_non_terminal_output(output_format, payload, items):
   146→        return True
   147→    return False
   148→
   149→
   150→def _plan_queue_context(
   151→    *,
   152→    state: dict,
   153→    plan_data: dict | None,
   154→) -> tuple[float | None, QueueBreakdown | None]:
   155→    plan_start_strict = get_plan_start_strict(plan_data)
   156→    try:
   157→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan_data)
   158→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   159→        breakdown = None
   160→    return plan_start_strict, breakdown
   161→
   162→
   163→def _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials: dict | None) -> dict | None:
   164→    try:
   165→        return merge_potentials(raw_potentials) or None
   166→    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError):
   167→        return raw_potentials or None
   168→
   169→
   170→def _get_items(args, state: dict, config: dict) -> None:
   171→    count = getattr(args, "count", 1) or 1
   172→    scope = getattr(args, "scope", None)
   173→    status = getattr(args, "status", "open")
   174→    group = getattr(args, "group", "item")
   175→    explain = bool(getattr(args, "explain", False))
   176→    cluster_arg = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   177→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   178→
   179→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config, fallback=95.0)
   180→
   181→    # Load the living plan
   182→    plan = load_plan()
   183→    plan_data: dict | None = None
   184→    if (
   185→        plan.get("queue_order")
   186→        or plan.get("overrides")
   187→        or plan.get("clusters")
   188→    ):
   189→        plan_data = plan
   190→
   191→    # Auto-scope to focus cluster if set and no explicit scope/cluster
   192→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(
   193→        plan_data,
   194→        cluster_arg=cluster_arg,
   195→        scope=scope,
   196→    )
   197→
   198→    queue = build_work_queue(
   199→        state,
   200→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   201→            count=count,
   202→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   203→            scope=scope,
   204→            status=status,
   205→            include_subjective=True,
   206→            subjective_threshold=target_strict,
   207→            explain=explain,
   208→            plan=plan_data,
   209→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   210→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   211→        ),
   212→    )
   213→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   214→
   215→    lang = resolve_lang(args)
   216→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   217→    narrative = compute_narrative(
   218→        state,
   219→        context=NarrativeContext(lang=lang_name, command="next", plan=plan_data),
   220→    )
   221→
   222→    payload = _build_next_payload(
   223→        queue=queue,
   224→        items=items,
   225→        state=state,
   226→        narrative=narrative,
   227→        plan_data=plan_data,
   228→    )
   229→    write_query(payload)
   230→
   231→    if _emit_requested_output(args, payload, items):
   232→        return
   233→
   234→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   235→    findings_scoped = state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   236→        state.get("findings", {}),
   237→        state.get("scan_path"),
   238→    )
   239→
   240→    # Extract frozen plan-start score and queue breakdown for lifecycle display
   241→    plan_start_strict, breakdown = _plan_queue_context(
   242→        state=state,
   243→        plan_data=plan_data,
   244→    )
   245→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   246→
   247→    next_render_mod.render_queue_header(queue, explain)
   248→    strict_score = state_mod.get_strict_score(state)
   249→    if next_render_mod.show_empty_queue(
   250→        queue,
   251→        strict_score,
   252→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   253→        target_strict=target_strict,
   254→    ):
   255→        return
   256→
   257→    raw_potentials = state.get("potentials", {})
   258→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials)
   259→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(
   260→        items, dim_scores, findings_scoped, group=group, explain=explain,
   261→        potentials=potentials, plan=plan_data,
   262→        cluster_filter=effective_cluster,
   263→    )
   264→    next_render_mod.render_single_item_resolution_hint(items)
   265→    next_render_mod.render_followup_nudges(
   266→        state,
   267→        dim_scores,
   268→        findings_scoped,
   269→        strict_score=strict_score,
   270→        target_strict_score=target_strict,
   271→        queue_total=queue_total,
   272→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   273→        breakdown=breakdown,
   274→    )
   275→    print()

    14→def _serialize_cluster_member(member: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    15→    """Serialize a cluster member without nested plan metadata."""
    16→    return {

    27→def serialize_item(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    28→    """Build a serializable output dict from a queue item."""
    29→    # Cluster meta-items get their own serialization
    30→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    31→        members_raw = item.get("members", [])
    32→        serialized_members = [
    33→            _serialize_cluster_member(member)
    34→            for member in members_raw[:_CLUSTER_MEMBER_SAMPLE_LIMIT]
    35→        ]
    36→        member_count = int(item.get("member_count", len(members_raw)))
    37→        serialized_cluster: dict[str, Any] = {
    38→            "id": item.get("id"),

    40→            "action_type": item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"),
    41→            "summary": item.get("summary"),
    42→            "member_count": member_count,

    44→            "cluster_name": item.get("cluster_name", item.get("id")),
    45→            "cluster_auto": item.get("cluster_auto", True),
    46→            "detector": item.get("detector"),
    47→        }
    48→        if member_count > len(serialized_members):
    49→            serialized_cluster["members_truncated"] = True
    50→            serialized_cluster["members_sample_limit"] = _CLUSTER_MEMBER_SAMPLE_LIMIT
    51→        serialized_cluster["primary_command"] = item.get("primary_command")
    52→        return serialized_cluster

    58→        "detector": item.get("detector"),

    93→
    94→def build_query_payload(
    95→    queue: Mapping[str, Any],
    96→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    97→    *,
    98→    command: str,
    99→    narrative: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
   100→    plan: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   101→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   102→    """Build JSON payload for query.json and non-terminal output modes."""
   103→    serialized = [serialize_item(item) for item in items]
   104→    queue_section: dict[str, Any] = {
   105→        "total": queue.get("total", len(items)),
   106→        "suppressed_count": queue.get("suppressed_count", 0),
   107→    }
   108→
   109→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   110→        "command": command,
   111→        "items": serialized,
   112→        "queue": queue_section,
   113→        "narrative": narrative,
   114→    }
   115→
   116→    if plan and (
   117→        plan.get("queue_order")
   118→        or plan.get("skipped")
   119→        or plan.get("clusters")
   120→    ):
   121→        clusters_summary = []
   122→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
   123→            member_ids = set(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   124→            clusters_summary.append({
   125→                "name": name,
   126→                "description": cluster.get("description"),
   127→                "item_count": len(member_ids),
   128→            })
   129→        payload["plan"] = {
   130→            "active": True,
   131→            "focus": plan.get("active_cluster"),
   132→            "clusters": clusters_summary,
   133→            "total_ordered": len(plan.get("queue_order", [])),
   134→            "total_skipped": len(plan.get("skipped", {})),
   135→            "plan_overrides_narrative": True,
   136→        }
   137→
   138→    return payload
   139→
   140→
   141→def render_markdown(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   142→    """Render queue items as markdown."""
   143→    lines = [
   144→        "# Desloppify Next Queue",
   145→        "",
   146→        "| Kind | Confidence | Summary | Command |",
   147→        "|------|------------|---------|---------|",
   148→    ]
   149→    for item in items:
   150→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   151→        conf = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   152→        summary = item.get("summary", "").replace("|", "\\|")
   153→        command = (item.get("primary_command", "") or "").replace("|", "\\|")
   154→        lines.append(f"| {kind} | {conf} | {summary} | {command} |")
   155→    lines.append("")
   156→    return "\n".join(lines)
   157→
   158→
   159→def write_output_file(
   160→    output_file: str,
   161→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   162→    item_count: int,
   163→    *,
   164→    safe_write_text_fn,
   165→    colorize_fn,
   166→) -> bool:
   167→    """Persist payload to file and print success/failure hints."""
   168→    try:
   169→        safe_write_text_fn(output_file, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
   170→        print(colorize_fn(f"Wrote {item_count} items to {output_file}", "green"))
   171→    except OSError as exc:
   172→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
   173→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="next output")
   174→        return False
   175→    return True
   176→
   177→
   178→def emit_non_terminal_output(
   179→    output_format: str,
   180→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   181→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
   182→) -> bool:
   183→    """Render JSON/markdown output variants."""
   184→    renderers = {
   185→        "json": lambda: print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2)),
   186→        "md": lambda: print(render_markdown(items)),
   187→    }
   188→    renderer = renderers.get(output_format)
   189→    if renderer is None:
   190→        return False
   191→    renderer()
   192→    return True
   193→
   194→

   197→    "emit_non_terminal_output",

   200→    "write_output_file",
   201→]

   258→def render_terminal_items(
   259→    items: list[dict],
   260→    dim_scores: dict,
   261→    findings_scoped: dict,
   262→    *,
   263→    group: str,
   264→    explain: bool,
   265→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   266→    plan: dict | None = None,
   267→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   268→) -> None:
   269→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   270→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   271→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   272→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   273→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   274→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   275→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   276→
   277→    if group != "item":
   278→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   279→        return
   280→
   281→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   282→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   283→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   284→    )
   285→
   286→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   287→        if idx > 0:
   288→            print()
   289→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   290→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   291→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   292→            continue
   293→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   294→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   295→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   296→        elif len(items) > 1:
   297→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   298→        else:
   299→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   300→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   301→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   302→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   303→
   304→
   305→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   306→    if len(items) != 1:
   307→        return
   308→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   309→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   310→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   311→    if kind != "finding":
   312→        return
   313→    item = items[0]
   314→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   315→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   316→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   317→        primary = item.get(
   318→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   319→        )
   320→        print(f"    {primary}")
   321→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   322→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   323→        return
   324→
   325→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   326→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   327→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   328→        print(f"    {primary}")
   329→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   330→    else:
   331→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   332→
   333→    print(
   334→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   335→    )
   336→    print(
   337→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   338→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'

   342→def render_followup_nudges(
   343→    state: dict,
   344→    dim_scores: dict,
   345→    findings_scoped: dict,
   346→    *,
   347→    strict_score: float | None,
   348→    target_strict_score: float,
   349→    queue_total: int = 0,
   350→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   351→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   352→) -> None:
   353→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   354→        format_queue_block,
   355→    )
   356→
   357→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   358→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   359→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   360→        state,
   361→        subjective_entries,
   362→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   363→        max_quality_items=3,
   364→        max_integrity_items=5,
   365→    )
   366→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   367→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   368→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   369→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   370→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   371→        print()
   372→        for text, style in block:
   373→            print(colorize(text, style))
   374→        print(colorize(
   375→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   376→            "dim",
   377→        ))
   378→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   379→        print(
   380→            colorize(
   381→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   382→                "cyan",
   383→            )
   384→        )
   385→        print(
   386→            colorize(
   387→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   388→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   389→                "dim",
   390→            )
   391→        )
   392→    elif strict_score is not None:
   393→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   394→        if gap > 0:
   395→            print(
   396→                colorize(
   397→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   398→                    "cyan",
   399→                )
   400→            )
   401→        else:
   402→            print(
   403→                colorize(
   404→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   405→                    "green",
   406→                )
   407→            )
   408→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   409→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   410→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   411→        for text, style in block:
   412→            print(colorize(text, style))
   413→
   414→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   415→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   416→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   417→    _objective_remaining = max(
   418→        0,
   419→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   420→    )
   421→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   422→        try:
   423→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   424→            subjective_drag = sum(
   425→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   426→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   427→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   428→            )
   429→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   430→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   431→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   432→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   433→            )
   434→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   435→                print(colorize(
   436→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   437→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   438→                    "yellow",
   439→                ))
   440→                print(colorize(
   441→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   442→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   443→                    "to re-score.",
   444→                    "yellow",
   445→                ))
   446→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   447→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   448→
   449→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   450→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   451→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   452→
   453→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   454→    if queue_total > 10:
   455→        print(colorize(
   456→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   457→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   458→            "dim",
   459→        ))
   460→
   461→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   462→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   463→        findings_scoped
   464→    )
   465→    parts: list[str] = []
   466→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   467→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   468→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   469→    open_review = [
   470→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   471→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   472→    ]
   473→    if low_dims:
   474→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   475→    if stale_count:
   476→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   477→    if unassessed_count:
   478→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   479→    if len(open_review):
   480→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   481→    if coverage_open > 0:
   482→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   483→
   484→    if parts:
   485→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   486→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   487→
   488→
   489→__all__ = [
   490→    "is_auto_fix_command",
   491→    "render_followup_nudges",
   492→    "render_gate_banner",

    72→        if isinstance(dim, str)

    75→    all_resolved = _resolve_all_patterns(state, args, attestation=attestation)
    76→    if not all_resolved:

    78→        print(colorize(f"No {status_label} findings matching: {' '.join(args.patterns)}", "yellow"))

    98→            else:

    12→    score_snapshot_or_warn as _score_snapshot_or_warn_support,

    14→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    15→
    16→
    17→def _print_resolve_summary(*, status: str, all_resolved: list[str]) -> None:
    18→    verb = "Reopened" if status == "open" else "Resolved"
    19→    print(colorize(f"\n{verb} {len(all_resolved)} finding(s) as {status}:", "green"))
    20→    for fid in all_resolved[:20]:
    21→        print(f"  {fid}")
    22→    if len(all_resolved) > 20:
    23→        print(f"  ... and {len(all_resolved) - 20} more")
    24→
    25→
    26→def _print_wontfix_batch_warning(
    27→    state: dict,
    28→    *,
    29→    status: str,
    30→    resolved_count: int,
    31→) -> None:
    32→    if status != "wontfix" or resolved_count <= 10:
    33→        return
    34→    wontfix_count = sum(
    35→        1 for finding in state["findings"].values() if finding["status"] == "wontfix"
    36→    )
    37→    actionable = sum(
    38→        1
    39→        for finding in state["findings"].values()
    40→        if finding["status"]
    41→        in ("open", "wontfix", "fixed", "auto_resolved", "false_positive")
    42→    )
    43→    wontfix_pct = round(wontfix_count / actionable * 100) if actionable else 0
    44→    print(
    45→        colorize(
    46→            f"\n  ⚠ Wontfix debt is now {wontfix_count} findings ({wontfix_pct}% of actionable).",
    47→            "yellow",
    48→        )
    49→    )
    50→    print(
    51→        colorize(
    52→            '    The strict score reflects this. Run `desloppify show "*" --status wontfix` to review.',
    53→            "dim",
    54→        )
    55→    )
    56→
    57→
    58→def _delta_suffix(delta: float) -> str:
    59→    if abs(delta) < 0.05:
    60→        return ""
    61→    return f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})"
    62→
    63→
    64→def _print_score_movement(
    65→    *,
    66→    status: str,
    67→    prev_overall: float | None,
    68→    prev_objective: float | None,
    69→    prev_strict: float | None,
    70→    prev_verified: float | None,
    71→    state: dict,
    72→    has_review_findings: bool = False,
    73→    target_strict: float | None = None,
    74→) -> None:
    75→    new = _score_snapshot_or_warn_support(
    76→        state,
    77→        score_snapshot_fn=state_mod.score_snapshot,
    78→        colorize_fn=colorize,
    79→        print_fn=print,
    80→    )
    81→    if new is None:
    82→        return
    83→
    84→    overall_delta = new.overall - (prev_overall or 0)
    85→    objective_delta = new.objective - (prev_objective or 0)
    86→    strict_delta = new.strict - (prev_strict or 0)
    87→    verified_delta = new.verified - (prev_verified or 0)
    88→    print(
    89→        f"\n  Scores: overall {new.overall:.1f}/100{_delta_suffix(overall_delta)}"
    90→        + colorize(
    91→            f"  objective {new.objective:.1f}/100{_delta_suffix(objective_delta)}",
    92→            "dim",
    93→        )
    94→        + colorize(f"  strict {new.strict:.1f}/100{_delta_suffix(strict_delta)}", "dim")
    95→        + colorize(
    96→            f"  verified {new.verified:.1f}/100{_delta_suffix(verified_delta)}", "dim"
    97→        )
    98→    )
    99→    if target_strict is not None:
   100→        _print_strict_target_nudge(new.strict, target_strict, show_next=False)
   101→    _print_strict_gap_note_support(
   102→        status,
   103→        overall=new.overall,
   104→        strict=new.strict,
   105→        colorize_fn=colorize,
   106→        print_fn=print,
   107→    )
   108→    _print_post_resolve_guidance_support(
   109→        status=status,
   110→        has_review_findings=has_review_findings,
   111→        overall_delta=overall_delta,
   112→        colorize_fn=colorize,
   113→        print_fn=print,
   114→    )
   115→
   116→
   117→def _print_subjective_reset_hint(
   118→    *,
   119→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   120→    state: dict,
   121→    all_resolved: list[str],
   122→    prev_subjective_scores: dict[str, float],
   123→) -> None:
   124→    has_review = any(
   125→        state["findings"].get(fid, {}).get("detector") == "review"
   126→        for fid in all_resolved
   127→    )
   128→    if not has_review or not state.get("subjective_assessments"):
   129→        return
   130→
   131→    stale_dims = sorted(
   132→        dim
   133→        for dim in {
   134→            str(
   135→                state["findings"].get(fid, {}).get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   136→            ).strip()
   137→            for fid in all_resolved
   138→            if state["findings"].get(fid, {}).get("detector") == "review"
   139→        }
   140→        if dim and dim in (state.get("subjective_assessments") or {})
   141→    )
   142→    if not stale_dims:
   143→        return
   144→
   145→    shown = ", ".join(stale_dims[:3])
   146→    if len(stale_dims) > 3:
   147→        shown = f"{shown}, +{len(stale_dims) - 3} more"
   148→    print(
   149→        colorize(
   150→            f"  Subjective scores unchanged — re-run review for updated scores: {shown}",
   151→            "yellow",
   152→        )
   153→    )
   154→    print(
   155→        colorize(
   156→            "  Next subjective step: "
   157→            + (
   158→                "`desloppify review --prepare --dimensions "
   159→                f"{','.join(stale_dims)} --force-review-rerun`"
   160→            ),
   161→            "dim",
   162→        )
   163→    )
   164→
   165→
   166→def _print_next_command(state: dict) -> str:
   167→    remaining = sum(
   168→        1
   169→        for finding in state["findings"].values()
   170→        if finding["status"] == "open"
   171→        and not finding.get("suppressed")
   172→    )
   173→    next_command = "desloppify scan"
   174→    if remaining > 0:
   175→        suffix = "s" if remaining != 1 else ""
   176→        print(
   177→            colorize(
   178→                f"\n  {remaining} finding{suffix} remaining — run `desloppify next`",
   179→                "dim",
   180→            )
   181→        )
   182→        next_command = "desloppify next"
   183→    print(colorize(f"  Next command: `{next_command}`", "dim"))
   184→    print()
   185→    return next_command
   186→

    39→def _missing_attestation_keywords(attestation: str | None) -> list[str]:
    40→    normalized = " ".join((attestation or "").strip().lower().split())
    41→    return [
    42→        phrase for phrase in _REQUIRED_ATTESTATION_PHRASES if phrase not in normalized
    43→    ]

    60→        _emit_warning(

    62→        )
    63→    _emit_warning(

    88→        sys.exit(1)

   106→    """Count unique open findings matching the provided patterns."""
   107→    matched_ids: set[str] = set()
   108→    for pattern in patterns:
   109→        for finding in state_mod.match_findings(state, pattern, status_filter="open"):
   110→            finding_id = finding.get("id")
   111→            if finding_id:
   112→                matched_ids.add(finding_id)
   113→    return len(matched_ids)
   114→
   115→
   116→def _estimate_wontfix_strict_delta(
   117→    state: dict,
   118→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   119→    *,
   120→    attestation: str | None,
   121→    resolve_all_patterns_fn,
   122→) -> float:
   123→    """Estimate strict score drop if this resolve command is applied as wontfix."""
   124→    before = state_mod.get_strict_score(state)
   125→    if before is None:
   126→        return 0.0
   127→
   128→    preview_state = copy.deepcopy(state)
   129→    resolve_all_patterns_fn(preview_state, args, attestation=attestation)
   130→    after = state_mod.get_strict_score(preview_state)
   131→    if after is None:
   132→        return 0.0
   133→    return max(0.0, before - after)
   134→
   135→
   136→def _enforce_batch_wontfix_confirmation(
   137→    state: dict,
   138→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   139→    *,
   140→    attestation: str | None,
   141→    resolve_all_patterns_fn,
   142→) -> None:
   143→    if args.status != "wontfix":
   144→        return
   145→
   146→    preview_count = _preview_resolve_count(state, args.patterns)
   147→    if preview_count <= 10:
   148→        return
   149→    if getattr(args, "confirm_batch_wontfix", False):
   150→        return
   151→
   152→    strict_delta = _estimate_wontfix_strict_delta(
   153→        state,
   154→        args,
   155→        attestation=attestation,
   156→        resolve_all_patterns_fn=resolve_all_patterns_fn,
   157→    )
   158→    _emit_warning(f"Large wontfix batch detected ({preview_count} findings).")
   159→    if strict_delta > 0:
   160→        _emit_warning(f"Estimated strict-score debt added now: {strict_delta:.1f} points.")
   161→    _emit_warning(
   162→        "Re-run with --confirm-batch-wontfix if this debt is intentional."
   163→    )
   164→    sys.exit(1)

    69→
    70→    entity = resolve_entity(pattern, state)

    73→        _show_concerns(state, lang_name)

    71→            snippet = read_code_snippet(finding["file"], target_line)
    72→            if snippet:
    73→                print(snippet)
    74→    if finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2:
    75→        print(
    76→            colorize(
    77→                f"      ⟳ reopened {finding['reopen_count']} times — fix properly or wontfix",
    78→                "red",
    79→            )
    80→        )
    81→    if finding.get("note"):
    82→        print(colorize(f"      note: {finding['note']}", "dim"))
    83→    print(colorize(f"      {finding['id']}", "dim"))
    84→
    85→
    86→def render_findings(
    87→    matches: list[dict],
    88→    *,
    89→    pattern: str,
    90→    status_filter: str,
    91→    show_code: bool,
    92→    top: int,
    93→    hidden_by_detector: dict[str, int],
    94→    hidden_total: int,
    95→    noise_budget: int,
    96→    global_noise_budget: int,
    97→    budget_warning: str | None,
    98→) -> None:
    99→    """Render grouped findings and rollup summary to terminal."""
   100→    sorted_files = group_matches_by_file(matches)
   101→    print(
   102→        colorize(
   103→            f"\n  {len(matches)} {status_filter} findings matching '{pattern}'\n",
   104→            "bold",
   105→        )
   106→    )
   107→    if budget_warning:
   108→        print(colorize(f"  {budget_warning}\n", "yellow"))
   109→    if hidden_total:
   110→        global_label = (
   111→            f", {global_noise_budget} global" if global_noise_budget > 0 else ""
   112→        )
   113→        hidden_parts = ", ".join(
   114→            f"{det}: +{count}" for det, count in hidden_by_detector.items()
   115→        )
   116→        print(
   117→            colorize(
   118→                (
   119→                    "  Noise budget: "
   120→                    f"{noise_budget}/detector{global_label} "
   121→                    f"({hidden_total} hidden: {hidden_parts})\n"
   122→                ),
   123→                "dim",
   124→            )
   125→        )
   126→
   127→    shown_files = sorted_files[:top]
   128→    remaining_files = sorted_files[top:]
   129→    remaining_findings = sum(len(files) for _, files in remaining_files)
   130→
   131→    for filepath, findings in shown_files:
   132→        findings.sort(
   133→            key=lambda finding: (
   134→                finding["tier"],
   135→                CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding["confidence"], 9),
   136→            )
   137→        )
   138→        display_path = "Codebase-wide" if filepath == "." else filepath
   139→        print(
   140→            colorize(f"  {display_path}", "cyan")
   141→            + colorize(f"  ({len(findings)} findings)", "dim")
   142→        )
   143→
   144→        for finding in findings:
   145→            _print_single_finding(finding, show_code=show_code)
   146→        print()
   147→
   148→    if remaining_findings:
   149→        print(
   150→            colorize(
   151→                (
   152→                    f"  ... and {len(remaining_files)} more files "
   153→                    f"({remaining_findings} findings). "
   154→                    f"Use --top {top + 20} to see more.\n"
   155→                ),
   156→                "dim",
   157→            )
   158→        )
   159→
   160→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
   161→    by_tier: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
   162→    for finding in matches:
   163→        by_detector[finding["detector"]] += 1
   164→        by_tier[finding["tier"]] += 1
   165→
   166→    print(colorize("  Summary:", "bold"))
   167→    print(
   168→        colorize(
   169→            (
   170→                "    By tier:     "
   171→                + ", ".join(
   172→                    f"T{tier}:{count}" for tier, count in sorted(by_tier.items())
   173→                )
   174→            ),
   175→            "dim",
   176→        )
   177→    )
   178→    print(
   179→        colorize(
   180→            (
   181→                "    By detector: "
   182→                + ", ".join(
   183→                    f"{detector}:{count}"
   184→                    for detector, count in sorted(
   185→                        by_detector.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1]
   186→                    )
   187→                )
   188→            ),
   189→            "dim",
   190→        )
   191→    )
   192→    if hidden_total:
   193→        print(
   194→            colorize(
   195→                (
   196→                    "    Hidden:      "
   197→                    + ", ".join(
   198→                        f"{detector}:+{count}"
   199→                        for detector, count in hidden_by_detector.items()
   200→                    )
   201→                ),
   202→                "dim",
   203→            )
   204→        )
   205→    print()
   206→
   207→
   208→def show_agent_plan(
   209→    narrative: dict, matches: list[dict], *, plan: dict | None = None
   210→) -> None:
   211→    """Render a compact plan from current findings and narrative actions.
   212→
   213→    When a living *plan* is active, renders plan focus/progress instead.
   214→    """
   215→    if plan and (plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("clusters")):
   216→        render_plan_with_living_plan(
   217→            [],
   218→            plan=plan,
   219→            header="  AGENT PLAN (use `desloppify next` to see your next task):",
   220→        )
   221→        return
   222→
   223→    actions = narrative.get("actions", [])
   224→    if not actions and not matches:
   225→        return
   226→
   227→    print(
   228→        colorize(
   229→            "  AGENT PLAN (use `desloppify next --count 20` to inspect more items):",
   230→            "yellow",
   231→        )
   232→    )
   233→    if actions:
   234→        top = actions[0]
   235→        print(
   236→            colorize(
   237→                f"  Agent focus: `{top['command']}` — {top['description']}",
   238→                "cyan",
   239→            )
   240→        )
   241→    elif matches:
   242→        first = matches[0]
   243→        print(
   244→            colorize(
   245→                "  Agent focus: `desloppify next --count 20` — "
   246→                f"inspect and resolve `{first.get('id', '')}`",
   247→                "cyan",
   248→            )
   249→        )
   250→
   251→    if print_ranked_actions(actions):
   252→        print()
   253→
   254→
   255→def show_subjective_followup(
   256→    state: dict, target_strict_score: float, *, objective_backlog: int = 0,
   257→) -> None:
   258→    """Show subjective follow-up guidance for the current state."""
   259→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   260→    if not dim_scores:
   261→        return
   262→
   263→    subjective = reporting_dimensions_mod.scorecard_subjective_entries(
   264→        state,
   265→        dim_scores=dim_scores,
   266→    )
   267→    if not subjective:
   268→        return
   269→
   270→    followup = reporting_dimensions_mod.build_subjective_followup(
   271→        state,
   272→        subjective,
   273→        threshold=target_strict_score,
   274→        max_quality_items=3,
   275→        max_integrity_items=5,
   276→    )
   277→    if print_subjective_followup(followup, objective_backlog=objective_backlog):
   278→        print()
   279→
   280→
   281→__all__ = [
   282→    "group_matches_by_file",
   283→    "render_findings",
   284→    "show_agent_plan",
   285→    "show_subjective_followup",
   286→    "write_show_output_file",

1→"""Scope and queue helpers for show command selection."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→
     7→from desloppify import scoring as scoring_mod
     8→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     9→from desloppify.core import registry as registry_mod
    10→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import (
    11→    QueueBuildOptions,
    12→    build_work_queue,
    13→)
    14→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    15→
    16→
    17→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    18→class ResolvedEntity:
    19→    """Classifies what the user's show pattern refers to."""
    20→
    21→    kind: str  # "dimension", "special_view", "file_or_pattern"
    22→    pattern: str  # Original user pattern
    23→    display_name: str  # Human-readable label
    24→    detectors: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # Detector names (for dimension kind)
    25→    is_subjective: bool = False  # Whether this is a subjective dimension
    26→
    27→
    28→def _resolve_special_view(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    29→    if lowered not in ("concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"):
    30→        return None
    31→    return ResolvedEntity(
    32→        kind="special_view",
    33→        pattern=pattern,
    34→        display_name=pattern,
    35→    )
    36→
    37→
    38→def _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern: str, lowered: str) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    39→    lookup = _build_dimension_lookup()
    40→    detectors = lookup.get(lowered) or lookup.get(pattern.lower())
    41→    if not detectors:
    42→        return None
    43→    dim_display = pattern
    44→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
    45→        dim_lowered = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    46→        if dim.name.lower() == lowered or dim_lowered == lowered:
    47→            dim_display = dim.name
    48→            break
    49→    return ResolvedEntity(
    50→        kind="dimension",
    51→        pattern=pattern,
    52→        display_name=dim_display,
    53→        detectors=tuple(detectors),
    54→        is_subjective=False,
    55→    )
    56→
    57→
    58→def _resolve_subjective_dimension(
    59→    pattern: str,
    60→    lowered: str,
    61→    state: dict,
    62→) -> ResolvedEntity | None:
    63→    display_name = scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.get(lowered)
    64→    if not display_name:
    65→        for key in state.get("dimension_scores") or {}:
    66→            if key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:
    67→                display_name = key
    68→                break
    69→    if not display_name:
    70→        return None
    71→    dim_data, display_name = _lookup_dimension_score(state, display_name)
    72→    is_subj = "subjective_assessment" in (
    73→        dim_data.get("detectors", {}) if isinstance(dim_data, dict) else {}
    74→    )
    75→    return ResolvedEntity(
    76→        kind="dimension",
    77→        pattern=pattern,
    78→        display_name=display_name,
    79→        detectors=(),
    80→        is_subjective=is_subj,
    81→    )
    82→
    83→
    84→def resolve_entity(pattern: str, state: dict) -> ResolvedEntity:
    85→    """Classify a user pattern as a dimension, special view, or passthrough.
    86→
    87→    Resolution priority:
    88→    1. Special views: "concerns", "subjective", "subjective_review"
    89→    2. Mechanical dimension name (from DIMENSIONS)
    90→    3. Subjective dimension name (from DISPLAY_NAMES / dimension_scores)
    91→    4. Everything else: file_or_pattern passthrough
    92→    """
    93→    lowered = pattern.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
    94→
    95→    # 1. Special views
    96→    special_view = _resolve_special_view(pattern, lowered)
    97→    if special_view is not None:
    98→        return special_view
    99→
   100→    # 2. Mechanical dimension (via DIMENSIONS list)
   101→    mechanical = _resolve_mechanical_dimension(pattern, lowered)
   102→    if mechanical is not None:
   103→        return mechanical
   104→
   105→    # 3. Subjective dimension (via DISPLAY_NAMES or dimension_scores)
   106→    subjective = _resolve_subjective_dimension(pattern, lowered, state)
   107→    if subjective is not None:
   108→        return subjective
   109→
   110→    # 4. Everything else
   111→    return ResolvedEntity(
   112→        kind="file_or_pattern",
   113→        pattern=pattern,
   114→        display_name=pattern,
   115→    )
   116→
   117→
   118→def _build_dimension_lookup() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   119→    """Build a map from dimension name/key (lowered) to detector names."""
   120→    lookup: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   121→    for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   122→        detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   123→        lookup[dim.name.lower()] = detectors
   124→        # Also index by underscore key: "file_health" -> detectors
   125→        key = dim.name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   126→        if key not in lookup:
   127→            lookup[key] = detectors
   128→    # Also add DISPLAY_NAMES reverse lookup (e.g. "abstraction_fit" -> "Abstraction Fit")
   129→    for key, display in scoring_mod.DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   130→        normalized_key = key.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   131→        normalized_display = display.lower()
   132→        # Find which dimension this belongs to via get_dimension_for_detector or direct name match
   133→        for dim in scoring_mod.DIMENSIONS:
   134→            dim_lower = dim.name.lower()
   135→            if normalized_display == dim_lower or normalized_key == dim_lower.replace(" ", "_"):
   136→                detectors = list(dim.detectors) if hasattr(dim, "detectors") else []
   137→                if normalized_key not in lookup:
   138→                    lookup[normalized_key] = detectors
   139→                if normalized_display not in lookup:
   140→                    lookup[normalized_display] = detectors
   141→    return lookup
   142→
   143→
   144→def _lookup_dimension_score(
   145→    state: dict, display_name: str,
   146→) -> tuple[dict, str]:
   147→    """Find dimension_scores entry with case-insensitive fallback.
   148→
   149→    Returns (dim_data_dict, resolved_display_name).
   150→    """
   151→    lowered = display_name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
   152→    dim_data = (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).get(display_name, {})
   153→    if not dim_data:
   154→        for ds_key, ds_val in (state.get("dimension_scores") or {}).items():
   155→            if ds_key.lower().replace(" ", "_") == lowered:
   156→                dim_data = ds_val
   157→                display_name = ds_key
   158→                break
   159→    return dim_data, display_name
   160→
   161→
   162→def _detector_names_hint() -> str:
   163→    """Return a compact list of detector names for the help message."""
   164→    names = getattr(registry_mod, "DISPLAY_ORDER", [])
   165→    if names:
   166→        return ", ".join(names[:10]) + (", ..." if len(names) > 10 else "")
   167→    return "smells, structural, security, review, ..."
   168→
   169→
   170→def resolve_show_scope(args) -> tuple[bool, str | None, str, str | None]:
   171→    """Resolve scope/pattern/status for a show invocation."""
   172→    chronic = getattr(args, "chronic", False)
   173→    pattern = args.pattern
   174→    status_filter = "open" if chronic else getattr(args, "status", "open")
   175→    if chronic:
   176→        scope = pattern
   177→        pattern = pattern or "<chronic>"
   178→        return True, pattern, status_filter, scope
   179→    if not pattern:
   180→        print(
   181→            colorize(
   182→                "Pattern required (or use --chronic). Try: desloppify show --help",
   183→                "yellow",
   184→            )
   185→        )
   186→        return False, None, status_filter, ""
   187→    return True, pattern, status_filter, pattern
   188→
   189→
   190→def load_matches(
   191→    state: dict,
   192→    *,
   193→    scope: str | None,
   194→    status_filter: str,
   195→    chronic: bool,
   196→) -> list[dict]:
   197→    """Load matching findings from the ranked queue."""
   198→    queue = build_work_queue(
   199→        state,
   200→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   201→            count=None,
   202→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   203→            scope=scope,
   204→            status=status_filter,
   205→            include_subjective=False,
   206→            chronic=chronic,
   207→        ),
   208→    )
   209→    return [item for item in queue.get("items", []) if item.get("kind") == "finding"]
   210→
   211→
   212→def resolve_noise(config: dict, matches: list[dict], *, no_budget: bool = False):
   213→    """Apply detector/global noise budget to show matches.
   214→
   215→    When *no_budget* is True, all matches are surfaced (nothing hidden).
   216→    """
   217→    if no_budget:
   218→        return (
   219→            matches,
   220→            {},
   221→            0,
   222→            0,
   223→            None,
   224→        )
   225→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   226→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   227→    )
   228→    surfaced_matches, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   229→        matches,
   230→        budget=noise_budget,
   231→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   232→    )
   233→    return (
   234→        surfaced_matches,
   235→        hidden_by_detector,
   236→        noise_budget,
   237→        global_noise_budget,
   238→        budget_warning,
   239→    )
   240→
   241→
   242→__all__ = [
   243→    "ResolvedEntity",
   244→    "_detector_names_hint",

   246→    "load_matches",
   247→    "resolve_entity",
   248→    "resolve_noise",
   249→    "resolve_show_scope",
   250→]
