   126→        for line, style in score_summary_lines(
   127→            overall_score=scores.overall,
   128→            objective_score=scores.objective,
   129→            strict_score=scores.strict,
   130→            verified_strict_score=scores.verified,
   131→            target_strict=target_strict_score,
   132→        ):
   133→            print(colorize(line, style))
   134→        # Show queue breakdown even without frozen score
   135→        if _breakdown is None:
   136→            try:
   137→                _breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, _plan)
   138→            except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   139→                _breakdown = None
   140→        if _breakdown is not None and _breakdown.queue_total > 0:
   141→            block = format_queue_block(_breakdown)
   142→            for text, style in block:
   143→                print(colorize(text, style))
   144→    print_scan_metrics(state)
   145→    print_open_scope_breakdown(state)
   146→    print_scan_completeness(state)
   147→
   148→    # Compute objective backlog once for consistent subjective actionability gating
   149→    _objective_backlog = 0
   150→    if _breakdown is not None:
   151→        _objective_backlog = max(0, _breakdown.queue_total - _breakdown.subjective)
   152→
   153→    if dim_scores:
   154→        show_dimension_table(state, dim_scores, objective_backlog=_objective_backlog)
   155→        reporting_dimensions_mod.show_score_model_breakdown(
   156→            state,
   157→            dim_scores=dim_scores,
   158→        )
   159→    else:
   160→        show_tier_progress_table(by_tier)
   161→
   162→    if dim_scores:
   163→        show_focus_suggestion(dim_scores, state, plan=_plan_active)
   164→        show_subjective_followup(
   165→            state,
   166→            dim_scores,
   167→            target_strict_score=target_strict_score,
   168→            objective_backlog=_objective_backlog,
   169→        )
   170→
   171→    show_review_summary(state)
   172→    show_structural_areas(state)
   173→    show_agent_plan(narrative, plan=_plan_active)
   174→
   175→    if narrative.get("headline"):
   176→        print(colorize(f"  -> {narrative['headline']}", "cyan"))
   177→        print()
   178→
   179→    if ignores:
   180→        show_ignore_summary(ignores, suppression)
   181→
   182→    review_age = config.get("review_max_age_days", 30)
   183→    if review_age != 30:
   184→        label = "never" if review_age == 0 else f"{review_age} days"
   185→        print(colorize(f"  Review staleness: {label}", "dim"))
   186→    print()
   187→
   188→    write_status_query(

   190→        stats=stats,
   191→        by_tier=by_tier,
   192→        dim_scores=dim_scores,
   193→        scorecard_dims=scorecard_dims,
   194→        subjective_measures=subjective_measures,
   195→        suppression=suppression,
   196→        narrative=narrative,
   197→        ignores=ignores,

   200→        strict_score=scores.strict,
   201→        verified_strict_score=scores.verified,
   202→        plan=_plan_active,
   203→    )
   204→
   205→
   206→def _status_json_payload(
   207→    state: dict,
   208→    stats: dict,
   209→    dim_scores: dict,
   210→    scorecard_dims: list[dict],
   211→    subjective_measures: list[dict],
   212→    suppression: dict,
   213→) -> dict:
   214→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   215→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   216→    open_scope = (
   217→        state_mod.open_scope_breakdown(findings, state.get("scan_path"))
   218→        if isinstance(findings, dict)
   219→        else None
   220→    )
   221→    return {
   222→        "overall_score": scores.overall,
   223→        "objective_score": scores.objective,
   224→        "strict_score": scores.strict,
   225→        "verified_strict_score": scores.verified,
   226→        "dimension_scores": dim_scores,
   227→        "score_breakdown": compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores) if dim_scores else None,
   228→        "scorecard_dimensions": scorecard_dims,
   229→        "subjective_measures": subjective_measures,
   230→        "potentials": state.get("potentials"),
   231→        "codebase_metrics": state.get("codebase_metrics"),
   232→        "stats": stats,
   233→        "open_scope": open_scope,
   234→        "suppression": suppression,
   235→        "scan_count": state.get("scan_count", 0),
   236→        "last_scan": state.get("last_scan"),
   237→    }
   238→
   239→__all__ = [
   240→    "cmd_status",

    10→class SubjectiveFollowup(Protocol):
    11→    """Contract for objects passed to print_subjective_followup."""
    12→
    13→    low_assessed: object  # falsy when no dimensions are below threshold
    14→    threshold_label: str
    15→    rendered: str
    16→    command: str
    17→    integrity_lines: list[tuple[str, str]]
    18→
    19→
    20→def print_subjective_followup(
    21→    followup: SubjectiveFollowup,
    22→    *,
    23→    leading_newline: bool = False,
    24→    objective_backlog: int = 0,
    25→) -> bool:
    26→    """Render common subjective quality/integrity guidance lines.
    27→
    28→    When *objective_backlog* > 0, quality nudges are suppressed entirely — the
    29→    queue already surfaces subjective work when it becomes actionable.
    30→    Integrity warnings are always shown (anti-gaming safeguard).
    31→
    32→    Returns True when any line is rendered.
    33→    """
    34→    printed = False
    35→    prefix = "\n" if leading_newline else ""
    36→    if followup.low_assessed and objective_backlog <= 0:
    37→        print(
    38→            colorize(
    39→                f"{prefix}  Subjective quality (<{followup.threshold_label}%): "
    40→                f"{followup.rendered}",
    41→                "cyan",
    42→            )
    43→        )
    44→        print(
    45→            colorize(
    46→                f"  Next command to improve subjective scores: {followup.command}",
    47→                "dim",
    48→            )
    49→        )
    50→        printed = True

    15→    header: str = "  AGENT PLAN:",

    35→def _print_plan_agent_block(plan: dict, *, header: str = "  AGENT PLAN:") -> None:

    45→    skipped = len(skipped_ids)
    46→    queue_order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    47→    plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)

    32→    plan: dict | None = None,
    33→) -> QueueBreakdown:
    34→    """Build a full :class:`QueueBreakdown` from a single ``build_work_queue`` call."""
    35→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    36→
    37→    result = build_work_queue(
    38→        state,
    39→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    40→            status="open",
    41→            count=None,
    42→            plan=plan,
    43→            collapse_clusters=True,
    44→            include_skipped=False,
    45→        ),
    46→    )
    47→
    48→    queue_total = result["total"]
    49→    suppressed = int(result.get("suppressed_count", 0))
    50→
    51→    # Count subjective and workflow items in the queue
    52→    items = result.get("items", [])
    53→    subjective = sum(
    54→        1 for item in items
    55→        if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension"
    56→    )
    57→    workflow = sum(
    58→        1 for item in items
    59→        if item.get("kind") in ("workflow_stage", "workflow_action")
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    # Plan-derived counts
    63→    plan_ordered = 0
    64→    skipped = 0
    65→    if plan:
    66→        skipped = len(plan.get("skipped", {}))
    67→        # plan_ordered = items that are in queue_order minus skipped
    68→        queue_order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    69→        skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    70→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    71→
    72→    # Focus cluster info
    73→    focus_cluster = None
    74→    focus_cluster_count = 0
    75→    focus_cluster_total = 0
    76→    if plan:
    77→        active = plan.get("active_cluster")
    78→        if active:
    79→            focus_cluster = active
    80→            cluster_data = plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
    81→            focus_cluster_total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
    82→            # Count how many cluster members are still in the queue
    83→            cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
    84→            open_findings = {
    85→                fid
    86→                for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    87→                if f.get("status") == "open"
    88→            }
    89→            focus_cluster_count = len(cluster_member_ids & open_findings)
    90→
    91→    return QueueBreakdown(
    92→        queue_total=queue_total,
    93→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
    94→        skipped=skipped,
    95→        subjective=subjective,
    96→        workflow=workflow,
    97→        suppressed=suppressed,
    98→        focus_cluster=focus_cluster,
    99→        focus_cluster_count=focus_cluster_count,
   100→        focus_cluster_total=focus_cluster_total,
   101→    )
   102→
   103→
   104→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   105→# Formatting helpers — single source of truth for queue display
   106→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   107→
   108→def format_queue_headline(breakdown: QueueBreakdown) -> str:
   109→    """The one-line Queue summary. Same format everywhere.
   110→
   111→    Examples::
   112→
   113→        Queue: 1934 items (292 planned · 23 skipped)
   114→        Queue: 1934 items
   115→    """
   116→    n = breakdown.queue_total
   117→    label = f"Queue: {n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
   118→
   119→    # Parenthesized segments
   120→    segments: list[str] = []
   121→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   122→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.workflow} planning step{'s' if breakdown.workflow != 1 else ''}")
   123→    if breakdown.plan_ordered > 0:
   124→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.plan_ordered} planned")
   125→    if breakdown.skipped > 0:
   126→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.skipped} skipped")
   127→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   128→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.subjective} subjective")
   129→    if breakdown.suppressed > 0:
   130→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.suppressed} suppressed")
   131→
   132→    if segments:
   133→        sep = " \u00b7 "
   134→        detail = sep.join(segments)
   135→        return f"{label} ({detail})"
   136→    return label
   137→
   138→
   139→def format_queue_block(
   140→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   141→    *,
   142→    frozen_score: float | None = None,
   143→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   144→    """Full queue block: focus banner + queue line + contextual hints.
   145→
   146→    Returns a list of ``(text, style)`` pairs ready for ``colorize()``.
   147→    """
   148→    lines: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
   149→
   150→    # Focus banner (prominent, separate)
   151→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   152→        focus_line = (
   153→            f"  Focus: `{breakdown.focus_cluster}` "
   154→            f"\u2014 {breakdown.focus_cluster_count}/{breakdown.focus_cluster_total}"
   155→            f" items remaining"
   156→        )
   157→        lines.append((focus_line, "cyan"))
   158→
   159→    # Frozen score line
   160→    if frozen_score is not None:
   161→        lines.append((
   162→            f"  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {frozen_score:.1f}/100",
   163→            "cyan",
   164→        ))
   165→
   166→    # Queue headline — always the same
   167→    lines.append((f"  {format_queue_headline(breakdown)}", "bold"))
   168→
   169→    # Contextual hints (dim)
   170→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   171→        lines.append((
   172→            f"  Unfocus: `desloppify plan focus --clear`"
   173→            f" \u00b7 Cluster details: `desloppify next --cluster {breakdown.focus_cluster} --count 10`",
   174→            "dim",
   175→        ))
   176→    elif breakdown.plan_ordered > 0 or breakdown.skipped > 0:
   177→        lines.append((
   178→            "  Details: `desloppify plan queue`"
   179→            " \u00b7 Skip: `desloppify plan skip <id>`",
   180→            "dim",
   181→        ))
   182→    else:
   183→        lines.append((
   184→            "  Start planning: `desloppify plan`",
   185→            "dim",
   186→        ))
   187→
   188→    return lines
   189→
   190→
   191→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   192→# Legacy / backward-compatible helpers
   193→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   194→
   195→def plan_aware_queue_count(state: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> int:
   196→    """Count remaining plan-aware queue items (skips excluded, clusters collapsed)."""
   197→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
   198→
   199→    result = build_work_queue(
   200→        state,
   201→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   202→            status="open",
   203→            count=None,
   204→            plan=plan,
   205→            collapse_clusters=True,
   206→            include_skipped=False,
   207→        ),
   208→    )
   209→    return result["total"]
   210→
   211→
   212→def get_plan_start_strict(plan: dict | None) -> float | None:
   213→    """Extract the frozen plan-start strict score, or None if unset."""
   214→    if not plan:
   215→        return None
   216→    return plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict")
   217→
   218→
   219→def print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   220→    plan: dict,
   221→    queue_remaining: int,
   222→    *,
   223→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None,
   224→) -> None:
   225→    """Show frozen plan-start score + queue progress.
   226→
   227→    When *breakdown* is provided, uses the standardized queue block.
   228→    Otherwise falls back to the legacy two-line format.
   229→    """
   230→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   231→    strict = scores.get("strict")
   232→    if strict is None:
   233→        return
   234→
   235→    if breakdown is not None:
   236→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=strict)
   237→        print()
   238→        for text, style in block:
   239→            print(colorize(text, style))
   240→        if queue_remaining > 0:
   241→            print(colorize(
   242→                "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   243→                "dim",
   244→            ))
   245→        return
   246→
   247→    # Legacy fallback
   248→    print(
   249→        colorize(
   250→            f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {strict:.1f}/100",
   251→            "cyan",
   252→        )
   253→    )
   254→    print(
   255→        colorize(
   256→            f"  Queue: {queue_remaining} item{'s' if queue_remaining != 1 else ''}"
   257→            " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   258→            "dim",
   259→        )
   260→    )
   261→
   262→
   263→def print_execution_or_reveal(
   264→    state: dict,
   265→    prev,
   266→    plan: dict | None,
   267→) -> None:
   268→    """Context-aware score display: frozen plan-start score or live scores.
   269→
   270→    If a plan has ``plan_start_scores`` and there are queue items remaining,
   271→    show the frozen score + queue progress.  Otherwise delegate to the
   272→    existing live ``print_score_update``.
   273→    """
   274→    if plan and plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict") is not None:
   275→        try:
   276→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   277→            remaining = breakdown.queue_total
   278→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   279→            breakdown = None
   280→            remaining = 0
   281→        if remaining > 0 and breakdown is not None:
   282→            print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   283→                plan, remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   284→            )
   285→            return
   286→
   287→    # No active plan cycle or queue is clear — live scores
   288→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score_update import print_score_update
   289→
   290→    print_score_update(state, prev)
   291→
   292→
   293→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   294→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   295→
   296→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   297→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   298→    """
   299→    from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   300→
   301→    try:
   302→        plan = load_plan()
   303→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   304→        plan = None
   305→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   306→
   307→
   308→__all__ = [
   309→    "QueueBreakdown",
   310→    "format_queue_block",
   311→    "format_queue_headline",
   312→    "get_plan_start_strict",
   313→    "plan_aware_queue_breakdown",
   314→    "plan_aware_queue_count",
   315→    "print_execution_or_reveal",
   316→    "print_frozen_score_with_queue_context",
   317→    "show_score_with_plan_context",
   318→]
   319→

1→"""Pattern → finding-ID resolution for plan commands."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel
     6→from desloppify.state import StateModel, match_findings
     7→
     8→
     9→def resolve_ids_from_patterns(
    10→    state: StateModel,
    11→    patterns: list[str],
    12→    *,
    13→    plan: PlanModel | None = None,
    14→    status_filter: str = "open",
    15→) -> list[str]:
    16→    """Resolve one or more patterns to a deduplicated list of finding IDs.
    17→
    18→    When *plan* is provided, literal IDs that exist only in the plan
    19→    (e.g. ``subjective::*`` synthetic items) are included even if they
    20→    have no corresponding entry in ``state["findings"]``.
    21→    """
    22→    seen: set[str] = set()
    23→    result: list[str] = []
    24→
    25→    # Collect all plan IDs for literal-match fallback
    26→    plan_ids: set[str] = set()
    27→    if plan is not None:
    28→        plan_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    29→        plan_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    30→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    31→            plan_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    32→
    33→    for pattern in patterns:
    34→        matches = match_findings(state, pattern, status_filter=status_filter)
    35→        if matches:
    36→            for finding in matches:
    37→                fid = finding["id"]
    38→                if fid not in seen:
    39→                    seen.add(fid)
    40→                    result.append(fid)
    41→        elif pattern in plan_ids and pattern not in seen:
    42→            # Literal plan ID (e.g. subjective::foo) not in state findings
    43→            seen.add(pattern)
    44→            result.append(pattern)
    45→        elif plan is not None and pattern in plan.get("clusters", {}):
    46→            # Cluster name → expand to member IDs
    47→            for fid in plan["clusters"][pattern].get("finding_ids", []):
    48→                if fid not in seen:
    49→                    seen.add(fid)
    50→                    result.append(fid)

    13→
    14→def _resolve_target(plan: dict, target: str | None, position: str) -> str | None:
    15→    """Resolve a cluster name used as a before/after target to a member ID."""
    16→    if target is None:
    17→        return None
    18→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    19→    if target not in clusters:
    20→        return target
    21→    member_ids = clusters[target].get("finding_ids", [])
    22→    if not member_ids:
    23→        return target
    24→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    25→    member_set = set(member_ids)
    26→    ordered = [fid for fid in order if fid in member_set]
    27→    if not ordered:
    28→        return member_ids[0]
    29→    return ordered[0] if position == "before" else ordered[-1]
    30→
    31→
    32→def cmd_plan_move(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    33→    """Move findings to a position in the queue."""
    34→    state = command_runtime(args).state
    35→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
    36→        return
    37→
    38→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
    39→    position: str = getattr(args, "position", "top")
    40→    target: str | None = getattr(args, "target", None)
    41→
    42→    if position in ("before", "after") and target is None:
    43→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t). Example: plan move <pat> {position} -t <id>", "red"))
    44→        return
    45→    if position in ("up", "down") and target is None:
    46→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t) with an integer offset. Example: plan move <pat> {position} -t 3", "red"))
    47→        return
    48→
    49→    plan = load_plan()
    50→

1→"""Cross-platform grep-style helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import os
     6→import re
     7→
     8→from desloppify.core._internal import text_utils as _text_utils
     9→from desloppify.search import grep_files_containing as _search_grep_files_containing
    10→from desloppify.core.source_discovery import read_file_text as _read_file_text
    11→
    12→_get_project_root = _text_utils.get_project_root
    13→
    14→
    15→def grep_files(
    16→    pattern: str, file_list: list[str], *, flags: int = 0
    17→) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:
    18→    """Search files for a regex pattern. Returns (filepath, lineno, line_text)."""
    19→    compiled = re.compile(pattern, flags)
    20→    results: list[tuple[str, int, str]] = []
    21→    for filepath in file_list:
    22→        abs_path = filepath if os.path.isabs(filepath) else str(_get_project_root() / filepath)
    23→        content = _read_file_text(abs_path)
    24→        if content is None:
    25→            continue
    26→        for lineno, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), 1):
    27→            if compiled.search(line):
    28→                results.append((filepath, lineno, line))
    29→    return results
    30→
    31→
    32→def grep_files_containing(
    33→    names: set[str], file_list: list[str], *, word_boundary: bool = True
    34→) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    35→    r"""Find which files contain which names. Returns {name: set(filepaths)}."""
    36→    return _search_grep_files_containing(
    37→        names,
    38→        file_list,
    39→        word_boundary=word_boundary,
    40→    )
    41→
    42→
    43→def grep_count_files(
    44→    name: str, file_list: list[str], *, word_boundary: bool = True
    45→) -> list[str]:
    46→    """Return list of files containing name."""
    47→    if word_boundary:
    48→        pat = re.compile(r"\b" + re.escape(name) + r"\b")
    49→    else:
    50→        pat = re.compile(re.escape(name))
    51→    matching: list[str] = []
    52→    for filepath in file_list:
    53→        abs_path = filepath if os.path.isabs(filepath) else str(_get_project_root() / filepath)
    54→        content = _read_file_text(abs_path)
    55→        if content is None:
    56→            continue
    57→        if pat.search(content):
    58→            matching.append(filepath)
    59→    return matching
    60→

1→<!-- desloppify-begin -->
     2→<!-- desloppify-skill-version: 2 -->
     3→---
     4→name: desloppify
     5→description: >
     6→  Codebase health scanner and technical debt tracker. Use when the user asks
     7→  about code quality, technical debt, dead code, large files, god classes,
     8→  duplicate functions, code smells, naming issues, import cycles, or coupling
     9→  problems. Also use when asked for a health score, what to fix next, or to
    10→  create a cleanup plan. Supports 28 languages.
    11→allowed-tools: Bash(desloppify *)
    12→---
    13→
    14→# Desloppify
    15→
    16→## 1. Your Job
    17→
    18→Maximise the **strict score** honestly. Your main cycle: **scan → plan → execute → rescan**. Follow the scan output's **INSTRUCTIONS FOR AGENTS** — don't substitute your own analysis.
    19→
    20→**Don't be lazy.** Do large refactors and small detailed fixes with equal energy. If it takes touching 20 files, touch 20 files. If it's a one-line change, make it. No task is too big or too small — fix things properly, not minimally.
    21→
    22→## 2. The Workflow
    23→
    24→Three phases, repeated as a cycle.
    25→
    26→### Phase 1: Scan and review — understand the codebase
    27→
    28→```bash
    29→desloppify scan --path .       # analyse the codebase
    30→desloppify status              # check scores — are we at target?
    31→```
    32→
    33→The scan will tell you if subjective dimensions need review. Follow its instructions. To trigger a review manually:
    34→```bash
    35→desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import
    36→```
    37→
    38→### Phase 2: Plan — decide what to work on
    39→
    40→After reviews, synthesis stages and plan creation appear as queue items in `next`. Complete them in order:
    41→```bash
    42→desloppify next                                        # shows the next workflow step
    43→desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "themes and root causes..."
    44→desloppify plan synthesize --stage reflect --report "comparison against completed work..."
    45→desloppify plan synthesize --stage organize --report "summary of priorities..."
    46→desloppify plan synthesize --complete --strategy "execution plan..."
    47→```
    48→
    49→Then shape the queue. **The plan shapes everything `next` gives you** — don't skip this step.
    50→
    51→```bash
    52→desloppify plan                          # see the full ordered queue
    53→desloppify plan move <pat> top           # reorder — what unblocks the most?
    54→desloppify plan cluster create <name>    # group related issues to batch-fix
    55→desloppify plan focus <cluster>          # scope next to one cluster
    56→desloppify plan skip <pat>              # defer — hide from next
    57→```
    58→
    59→More plan commands:
    60→```bash
    61→desloppify plan move <cluster> top       # move all cluster members at once
    62→desloppify plan move <a> <b> top         # mix clusters + findings in one move
    63→desloppify plan move <pat> before -t X   # position relative to another item/cluster
    64→desloppify plan cluster move a,b top     # move multiple clusters as one block
    65→desloppify plan done <pat>               # mark complete
    66→desloppify plan reopen <pat>             # reopen
    67→```
    68→
    69→### Phase 3: Execute — grind the queue to completion
    70→
    71→Trust the plan and execute. Don't rescan mid-queue — finish the queue first.
    72→
    73→```
    74→1. desloppify next              ← what to fix next
    75→2. Fix the issue in code
    76→3. Resolve it (next shows you the exact command including required attestation)
    77→4. Repeat until the queue is empty
    78→```
    79→
    80→Score may temporarily drop after fixes — cascade effects are normal, keep going.
    81→If `next` suggests an auto-fixer, run `desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run` to preview, then apply.
    82→
    83→**When the queue is clear, go back to Phase 1.** New issues will surface, cascades will have resolved, priorities will have shifted. This is the cycle.
    84→
    85→### Other useful commands
    86→
    87→```bash
    88→desloppify next --count 5                         # top 5 priorities
    89→desloppify next --cluster <name>                  # drill into a cluster
    90→desloppify show <pattern>                         # filter by file/detector/ID
    91→desloppify show --status open                     # all open findings
    92→desloppify plan skip --permanent "<id>" --note "reason" --attest "..." # accept debt
    93→desloppify exclude <path>                         # exclude a directory from scanning
    94→desloppify config show                            # show all config including excludes
    95→desloppify scan --path . --reset-subjective       # reset subjective baseline to 0
    96→```
    97→
    98→## 3. Reference
    99→
   100→### How scoring works
   101→
   102→Overall score = **40% mechanical** + **60% subjective**.
   103→
   104→- **Mechanical (40%)**: auto-detected issues — duplication, dead code, smells, unused imports, security. Fixed by changing code and rescanning.
   105→- **Subjective (60%)**: design quality review — naming, error handling, abstractions, clarity. Starts at **0%** until reviewed. The scan will prompt you when a review is needed.
   106→- **Strict score** is the north star: wontfix items count as open. The gap between overall and strict is your wontfix debt.
   107→- **Score types**: overall (lenient), strict (wontfix counts), objective (mechanical only), verified (confirmed fixes only).
   108→
   109→### Subjective reviews in detail
   110→
   111→- **Preferred**: `desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` — does everything in one command.
   112→- **Manual path**: `desloppify review --prepare` → review per dimension → `desloppify review --import file.json`.
   113→- Import first, fix after — import creates tracked state entries for correlation.
   114→- Integrity: reviewers score from evidence only. Scores hitting exact targets trigger auto-reset.
   115→- Even moderate scores (60-80) dramatically improve overall health.
   116→- Stale dimensions auto-surface in `next` — just follow the queue.
   117→
   118→### Key concepts
   119→
   120→- **Tiers**: T1 auto-fix → T2 quick manual → T3 judgment call → T4 major refactor.
   121→- **Auto-clusters**: related findings are auto-grouped in `next`. Drill in with `next --cluster <name>`.
   122→- **Zones**: production/script (scored), test/config/generated/vendor (not scored). Fix with `zone set`.
   123→- **Wontfix cost**: widens the lenient↔strict gap. Challenge past decisions when the gap grows.
   124→- Score can temporarily drop after fixes (cascade effects are normal).
   125→
   126→## 4. Escalate Tool Issues Upstream
   127→
   128→When desloppify itself appears wrong or inconsistent:
   129→
   130→1. Capture a minimal repro (`command`, `path`, `expected`, `actual`).
   131→2. Open a GitHub issue in `peteromallet/desloppify`.
   132→3. If you can fix it safely, open a PR linked to that issue.
   133→4. If unsure whether it is tool bug vs user workflow, issue first, PR second.
   134→
   135→## Prerequisite
   136→
   137→`command -v desloppify >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "desloppify: installed" || echo "NOT INSTALLED — run: pip install --upgrade git+https://github.com/peteromallet/desloppify.git"`
   138→
   139→<!-- desloppify-end -->
   140→

    10→def _plan_with_queue(*finding_ids: str, clustered: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    11→    """Build a plan with given queue items and optional clustered IDs."""
    12→    plan = empty_plan()
    13→    plan["queue_order"] = [SYNTHESIS_ID] + list(finding_ids)
    14→    if clustered:
    15→        plan["clusters"]["test-cluster"] = {
    16→            "name": "test-cluster",
    17→            "finding_ids": list(clustered),
    18→            "description": "Test",
    19→            "action_steps": ["step 1"],
    20→            "auto": False,
    21→        }
    22→    return plan
    23→
    24→
    25→def _review_ids(*ids: str) -> set[str]:
    26→    """Convenience wrapper to build an open_review_ids set."""
    27→    return set(ids)
    28→
    29→
    30→class TestSynthesisCoverage:
    31→    def test_coverage_excludes_non_review_items(self):
    32→        """Non-review queue items (mechanical findings) don't inflate total."""
    33→        plan = _plan_with_queue(
    34→            "review::test.py::naming_issue",
    35→            "review::test.py::coupling_issue",
    36→            "naming-convention::test.py",  # mechanical — should be excluded
    37→            "unused-import::test.py",       # mechanical — should be excluded
    38→            clustered=["review::test.py::naming_issue"],
    39→        )
    40→        organized, total, _ = _synthesis_coverage(
    41→            plan,
    42→            open_review_ids=_review_ids(
    43→                "review::test.py::naming_issue",
    44→                "review::test.py::coupling_issue",
    45→            ),
    46→        )

    48→        assert organized == 1
    49→

    13→def _plan_with_synthesis_stages(*confirmed_stages: str) -> dict:
    14→    """Build a plan with all synthesis stages in queue, some confirmed."""
    15→    plan = empty_plan()
    16→    plan["queue_order"] = list(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS)
    17→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    18→    stages = meta.setdefault("synthesis_stages", {})
    19→    for name in confirmed_stages:
    20→        stages[name] = {
    21→            "stage": name,
    22→            "report": f"Report for {name}",
    23→            "timestamp": "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z",
    24→        }
    25→    return plan
    26→
    27→
    28→def _args(**overrides) -> argparse.Namespace:
    29→    defaults = {
    30→        "patterns": [],
    31→        "attest": None,
    32→        "note": None,
    33→        "confirm": False,
    34→        "force_resolve": False,
    35→        "state": None,
    36→        "lang": None,
    37→        "path": None,
    38→        "exclude": None,
    39→    }
    40→    defaults.update(overrides)
    41→    return argparse.Namespace(**defaults)

     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.state import StateModel
     6→
     7→
     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
     9→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    10→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    11→    if not scan_history:
    12→        return set()
    13→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    14→    if not threshold:
    15→        return set()
    16→    return {
    17→        finding_id
    18→        for finding_id, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    19→        if finding.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
    20→    }
    21→
    22→
    23→def _enforce_workflow_stage_order(items: list[dict]) -> None:
    24→    """Re-sort workflow_stage items in-place: unblocked before blocked."""
    25→    stage_entries = [(i, item) for i, item in enumerate(items)
    26→                     if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage"]
    27→    if len(stage_entries) <= 1:
    28→        return
    29→    sorted_stages = sorted(
    30→        [item for _, item in stage_entries],
    31→        key=lambda it: (1 if it.get("is_blocked") else 0, int(it.get("stage_index", 0))),
    32→    )
    33→    for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
    34→        items[idx] = replacement
    35→
    36→
    37→def apply_plan_order(
    38→    items: list[dict],
    39→    plan: dict,
    40→    *,
    41→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    42→    cluster: str | None = None,
    43→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
    44→) -> list[dict]:
    45→    """Reorder items according to the living plan."""
    46→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    47→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    48→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    49→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    50→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    51→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    52→
    53→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    54→    for item in items:
    55→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    56→
    57→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    58→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    59→        if override.get("description"):
    60→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    61→        if override.get("note"):
    62→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    63→        if override.get("cluster"):
    64→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    65→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    66→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    67→                "name": cluster_name,
    68→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    69→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    70→            }
    71→
    72→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    73→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    74→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    75→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    76→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    77→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    78→
    79→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
    80→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
    81→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
    82→    _new = new_ids or set()
    83→    for item in items:
    84→        item_id = item["id"]
    85→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
    86→            continue
    87→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
    88→            skipped_items.append(item)
    89→        elif item_id in _new:
    90→            remaining_new.append(item)
    91→        else:
    92→            remaining_existing.append(item)
    93→
    94→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
    95→    _enforce_workflow_stage_order(result)
    96→    if include_skipped:
    97→        result = result + skipped_items
    98→
    99→    for position, item in enumerate(result):
   100→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   101→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   102→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   103→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   104→            if skip_entry:
   105→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")

150→
   151→def move_items(
   152→    plan: PlanModel,
   153→    finding_ids: list[str],
   154→    position: str,
   155→    target: str | None = None,
   156→    offset: int | None = None,
   157→) -> int:
   158→    """Move finding IDs to a position in queue_order. Returns count moved."""
   159→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   160→
   161→    # Triage stage IDs are workflow-managed and cannot be manually reordered
   162→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import TRIAGE_IDS
   163→    finding_ids = [fid for fid in finding_ids if fid not in TRIAGE_IDS]
   164→    if not finding_ids:
   165→        return 0
   166→
   167→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   168→
   169→    # Remove from skipped if present
   170→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan.get("skipped", {})
   171→    for fid in finding_ids:
   172→        skipped.pop(fid, None)
   173→
   174→    # Remove from current position in order
   175→    for fid in finding_ids:
   176→        if fid in order:
   177→            order.remove(fid)
   178→
   179→    # Resolve insertion point
   180→    idx = _resolve_position(order, position, target, offset, finding_ids)
   181→
   182→    # Insert in original order
   183→    for i, fid in enumerate(finding_ids):
   184→        order.insert(idx + i, fid)
   185→
   186→    # Track user-promoted IDs only when explicitly moved to the front.
   187→    # Moving to bottom/down/after should not create a promotion barrier.
   188→    if position == "top":
   189→        promoted: list[str] = plan.get("promoted_ids", [])
   190→        existing_promoted = set(promoted)
   191→        for fid in finding_ids:
   192→            if fid not in existing_promoted:
   193→                promoted.append(fid)
   194→                existing_promoted.add(fid)
   195→        plan["promoted_ids"] = promoted
   196→
   197→    return len(finding_ids)
   198→
   199→

## Summary

### Task 1: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/plan_order.py`

Added the `_enforce_workflow_stage_order()` function (lines 23-34) which re-sorts `workflow_stage` items in-place so that unblocked stages appear before blocked ones, with secondary sorting by `stage_index`. The function is called at line 95, immediately after building the `result` list from `ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new` but before the `include_skipped` append and `queue_position` assignment. The function was also added to `__all__`.

### Task 2: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/operations.py`

Added a triage stage guard at the top of `move_items()` (lines 161-165) that filters out any finding IDs matching `TRIAGE_IDS` (imported from `stale_dimensions`). If all IDs are triage IDs, the function returns 0 early. Also updated the `epic/` prefix error message from "reserved for synthesis epics" to "reserved for triage epics" (line 337).

### Task 3: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/queue_render.py`

Added a `[TRIAGE] ` prefix to the summary display for `workflow_stage` items in the `_build_rows()` function (line 109). The summary now renders as `[TRIAGE] <summary text><blocked_tag>` instead of just `<summary text><blocked_tag>`.

  "new_string": "def migrate_v5_to_v6(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Migrate v5 → v6: unified queue system.\"\"\"\n    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (\n        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,\n        WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID,\n    )\n\n    order: list[str] = plan.get(\"queue_order\", [])\n\n    # Handle legacy synthesis::pending or triage::pending\n    for legacy_pending in (\"synthesis::pending\", \"triage::pending\"):\n        if legacy_pending in order:\n            idx = order.index(legacy_pending)\n            order.remove(legacy_pending)\n            meta = plan.get(\"epic_triage_meta\", plan.get(\"epic_synthesis_meta\", {}))\n            confirmed = set(meta.get(\"triage_stages\", meta.get(\"synthesis_stages\", {})).keys())\n            stage_names = (\"observe\", \"reflect\", \"organize\", \"commit\")\n            to_inject = [\n                stage_id\n                for stage_id, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)\n                if name not in confirmed and stage_id not in order\n            ]\n            for offset, stage_id in enumerate(to_inject):\n                order.insert(idx + offset, stage_id)\n            break\n\n    if plan.pop(\"pending_plan_gate\", False):\n        if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID not in order:\n            insert_at = 0\n            for idx, finding_id in enumerate(order):\n                if finding_id.startswith(\"triage::\") or finding_id.startswith(\"synthesis::\"):\n                    insert_at = idx + 1\n            order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)\n    else:\n        plan.pop(\"pending_plan_gate\", None)"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"Stage persistence helpers for triage command handlers.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom desloppify.engine.planning.triage import review_finding_snapshot_hash\nfrom desloppify.state import utc_now\nfrom desloppify.engine.plan import save_plan\n\n\ndef refresh_stage_snapshot(plan: dict, state: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Mark stage progress as aligned with the current review-finding snapshot.\"\"\"\n    meta = plan.setdefault(\"epic_triage_meta\", {})\n    meta[\"stage_snapshot_hash\"] = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)\n    meta[\"stage_refresh_required\"] = False\n\n\ndef record_triage_stage(\n    plan: dict,\n    state: dict,\n    *,\n    stage: str,\n    report: str,\n    cited_ids: list[str],\n    finding_count: int,\n    extra: dict[str, object] | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n    \"\"\"Persist one stage payload, refresh snapshot metadata, and save the plan.\"\"\"\n    meta = plan.setdefault(\"epic_triage_meta\", {})\n    stages = meta.setdefault(\"triage_stages\", {})\n    payload: dict[str, object] = {\n        \"stage\": stage,\n        \"report\": report,\n        \"cited_ids\": list(cited_ids),\n        \"timestamp\": utc_now(),\n        \"finding_count\": finding_count,\n    }\n    if extra:\n        payload.update(extra)\n    stages[stage] = payload\n    refresh_stage_snapshot(plan, state)\n    save_plan(plan)\n    return payload\n"
}

  "new_string": "def migrate_synthesis_to_triage(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Migrate synthesis::* → triage::* naming throughout the plan.\n\n    - Renames ``synthesis::*`` IDs to ``triage::*`` in ``queue_order`` and ``skipped``\n    - Renames ``epic_synthesis_meta`` key to ``epic_triage_meta``\n    - Renames ``synthesis_stages`` to ``triage_stages`` inside that meta dict\n    - Renames ``synthesized_ids`` to ``triaged_ids`` inside that meta dict\n    - Renames ``synthesis_version`` to ``triage_version`` in cluster dicts\n    \"\"\"\n    # Rename synthesis::* IDs in queue_order\n    order: list[str] = plan.get(\"queue_order\", [])\n    for i, fid in enumerate(order):\n        if fid.startswith(\"synthesis::\"):\n            order[i] = \"triage::\" + fid[len(\"synthesis::\"):]\n\n    # Rename synthesis::* IDs in skipped\n    skipped: dict = plan.get(\"skipped\", {})\n    synth_keys = [k for k in skipped if k.startswith(\"synthesis::\")]\n    for old_key in synth_keys:\n        new_key = \"triage::\" + old_key[len(\"synthesis::\"):]\n        entry = skipped.pop(old_key)\n        if isinstance(entry, dict):\n            entry[\"finding_id\"] = new_key\n        skipped[new_key] = entry\n\n    # Rename epic_synthesis_meta → epic_triage_meta\n    if \"epic_synthesis_meta\" in plan:\n        meta = plan.pop(\"epic_synthesis_meta\")\n        if isinstance(meta, dict):\n            # Rename synthesis_stages → triage_stages\n            if \"synthesis_stages\" in meta:\n                meta[\"triage_stages\"] = meta.pop(\"synthesis_stages\")\n            # Rename synthesized_ids → triaged_ids\n            if \"synthesized_ids\" in meta:\n                meta[\"triaged_ids\"] = meta.pop(\"synthesized_ids\")\n        plan[\"epic_triage_meta\"] = meta\n\n    # Rename synthesis_version → triage_version in clusters\n    for cluster in plan.get(\"clusters\", {}).values():\n        if not isinstance(cluster, dict):\n            continue\n        if \"synthesis_version\" in cluster:\n            cluster[\"triage_version\"] = cluster.pop(\"synthesis_version\")\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"ensure_container_types\",\n    \"migrate_deferred_to_skipped\",\n    \"migrate_epics_to_clusters\",\n    \"migrate_synthesis_to_triage\",\n    \"migrate_v5_to_v6\",\n    \"normalize_cluster_defaults\",\n]"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"Reflect-stage dashboard rendering helpers.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom desloppify.core.output import colorize\nfrom desloppify.engine.planning.triage import detect_recurring_patterns\n\n\ndef _print_reflect_dashboard(si: object, plan: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Show completed clusters, resolved findings, and recurring patterns.\"\"\"\n    completed = getattr(si, \"completed_clusters\", [])\n    resolved = getattr(si, \"resolved_findings\", {})\n    open_findings = getattr(si, \"open_findings\", {})\n\n    _print_completed_clusters(completed)\n    _print_resolved_findings(resolved)\n    recurring = _print_recurring_patterns(open_findings, resolved)\n    if not recurring and not completed and not resolved:\n        print(colorize(\"\\n  First triage — no prior work to compare against.\", \"dim\"))\n        print(colorize(\"  Focus your reflect report on your strategy:\", \"yellow\"))\n        print(\n            colorize(\n                \"  - How will you resolve contradictions you identified in observe?\",\n                \"dim\",\n            )\n        )\n        print(colorize(\"  - Which findings will you cluster together vs defer?\", \"dim\"))\n        print(colorize(\"  - What's the overall arc of work and why?\", \"dim\"))\n\n\ndef _print_completed_clusters(completed: list[dict]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Print completed cluster context for reflect stage.\"\"\"\n    if not completed:\n        return\n    print(colorize(\"\\n  Previously completed clusters:\", \"cyan\"))\n    for cluster in completed[:10]:\n        name = cluster.get(\"name\", \"?\")\n        count = len(cluster.get(\"finding_ids\", []))\n        thesis = cluster.get(\"thesis\", \"\")\n        print(f\"    {name}: {count} findings\")\n        if thesis:\n            print(colorize(f\"      {thesis}\", \"dim\"))\n        for step in cluster.get(\"action_steps\", [])[:3]:\n            print(colorize(f\"      - {step}\", \"dim\"))\n    if len(completed) > 10:\n        print(colorize(f\"    ... and {len(completed) - 10} more\", \"dim\"))\n\n\ndef _print_resolved_findings(resolved: dict[str, dict]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Print resolved findings delta since last triage.\"\"\"\n    if not resolved:\n        return\n    print(colorize(f\"\\n  Resolved findings since last triage: {len(resolved)}\", \"cyan\"))\n    for finding_id, finding in sorted(resolved.items())[:10]:\n        status = finding.get(\"status\", \"\")\n        summary = finding.get(\"summary\", \"\")\n        detail = finding.get(\"detail\", {}) if isinstance(finding.get(\"detail\"), dict) else {}\n        dim = detail.get(\"dimension\", \"\")\n        print(f\"    [{status}] [{dim}] {summary}\")\n        print(colorize(f\"      {finding_id}\", \"dim\"))\n    if len(resolved) > 10:\n        print(colorize(f\"    ... and {len(resolved) - 10} more\", \"dim\"))\n\n\ndef _print_recurring_patterns(open_findings: dict, resolved: dict[str, dict]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Print recurring pattern diagnostics for reflect stage.\"\"\"\n    recurring = detect_recurring_patterns(open_findings, resolved)\n    if not recurring:\n        return False\n    print(colorize(\"\\n  Recurring patterns detected:\", \"yellow\"))\n    for dim, info in sorted(recurring.items()):\n        resolved_count = len(info[\"resolved\"])\n        open_count = len(info[\"open\"])\n        label = \"potential loop\" if open_count >= resolved_count else \"root cause unaddressed\"\n        print(\n            colorize(\n                f\"    {dim}: {resolved_count} resolved, {open_count} still open \\u2014 {label}\",\n                \"yellow\",\n            )\n        )\n    return True\n"
}

    40→def extract_finding_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
    41→    """Extract finding IDs cited in free text.

    43→    Matches full finding IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
    44→    hex suffixes that correspond to a known finding.

    50→        if candidate in valid_ids:
    51→            cited.add(candidate)
    52→    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
    53→    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
    54→        for valid_id in valid_ids:
    55→            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
    56→                cited.add(valid_id)
    57→                break
    58→    return cited

   184→def collect_triage_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> TriageInput:
   185→    """Gather all data needed for the synthesis LLM prompt."""
   186→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   187→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   188→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   189→    epics = triage_clusters(plan)
   190→
   191→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
   192→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
   193→    for fid, f in findings.items():
   194→        if f.get("status") != "open":
   195→            continue
   196→        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
   197→            open_review[fid] = f
   198→        else:
   199→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
   200→
   201→    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
   202→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   203→    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
   204→    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
   205→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   206→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   207→
   208→    # Resolved finding objects (for REFLECT stage)
   209→    resolved_finding_objs = {
   210→        fid: findings[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in findings
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    # Completed clusters since last synthesis completion
   214→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   215→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   216→    if last_completed:
   217→        recent_completed = [
   218→            c for c in all_completed
   219→            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   220→        ]
   221→    else:
   222→        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
   223→
   224→    return TriageInput(
   225→        open_findings=open_review,
   226→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   227→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   228→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   229→        new_since_last=new_since,
   230→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   231→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   232→        synthesis_version=version,
   233→        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
   234→        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   235→    )

   242→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   243→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   244→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   245→
   246→Your plan should:
   247→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   248→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   249→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   250→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   251→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   252→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   253→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   254→
   255→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   256→
   257→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   258→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   259→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   260→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   261→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   262→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   263→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   264→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   265→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   266→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   267→
   268→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   269→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   270→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   271→
   272→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   273→{
   274→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   275→  "epics": [
   276→    {
   277→      "name": "slug-name",
   278→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   279→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   280→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   281→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   282→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   283→      "agent_safe": true,
   284→      "dependency_order": 1,
   285→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   286→      "status": "pending"
   287→    }
   288→  ],
   289→  "dismissed_findings": [
   290→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "contradiction_notes": [
   293→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   294→  ],
   295→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   296→}
   297→"""
   298→
   299→
   300→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   301→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   302→    parts: list[str] = []
   303→
   304→    # Section: existing epics
   305→    if si.existing_epics:
   306→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   307→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   308→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   309→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   310→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   311→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   312→            parts.append(
   313→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   314→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   315→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   316→            )
   317→        parts.append("")
   318→
   319→    # Section: what changed
   320→    if si.new_since_last:
   321→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   322→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   323→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   324→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   325→        parts.append("")
   326→
   327→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   328→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   329→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   330→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   331→        parts.append("")
   332→
   333→    # Section: all open review findings
   334→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   335→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   336→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   337→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   338→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   339→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   340→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   341→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   342→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   344→        if dimension:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   346→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   347→        if suggestion:
   348→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   349→    parts.append("")
   350→
   351→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   352→    if si.dimension_scores:
   353→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   354→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   355→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   356→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   357→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   358→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   359→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   360→        parts.append("")
   361→
   362→    # Section: previously dismissed
   363→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   364→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   365→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   366→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   367→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   368→        parts.append("")
   369→
   370→    return "\n".join(parts)
   371→
   372→
   373→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   374→# Result parsing
   375→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   376→
   377→def parse_triage_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> TriageResult:
   378→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a TriageResult.
   379→
   380→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   381→    """
   382→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   383→
   384→    epics: list[dict] = []
   385→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   386→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   387→            continue
   388→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   389→        if not name:
   390→            continue
   391→        # Validate direction
   392→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   393→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   394→            direction = "simplify"
   395→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   396→        finding_ids = [
   397→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   398→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   399→        ]
   400→        dismissed = [
   401→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   402→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   403→        ]
   404→        action_steps = [
   405→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   406→            if isinstance(s, str)
   407→        ]
   408→
   409→        epics.append({
   410→            "name": name,
   411→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   412→            "direction": direction,
   413→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   414→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   415→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   416→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   417→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   418→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   419→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   420→        })
   421→
   422→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   423→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   424→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   425→            continue
   426→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   427→        if fid in valid_ids:
   428→            dismissed_findings.append(
   429→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   430→            )
   431→
   432→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   433→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   434→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   435→            continue
   436→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   437→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   438→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   439→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   440→        ))
   441→
   442→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   443→
   444→    return TriageResult(
   445→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   446→        epics=epics,
   447→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   448→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   449→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   450→    )
   451→
   452→
   453→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   454→# Plan mutation
   455→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   456→
   457→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   458→    plan: PlanModel,
   459→    state: StateModel,
   460→    synthesis: TriageResult,
   461→    *,
   462→    trigger: str = "manual",
   463→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   464→    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   465→
   466→    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   467→    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   468→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   469→    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   470→    """
   471→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   472→    now = utc_now()
   473→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   474→    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   475→
   476→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   477→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   478→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   479→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   480→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   481→    result.synthesis_version = version
   482→
   483→    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
   484→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   485→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   486→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   487→
   488→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   489→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   490→            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
   491→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   492→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   493→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   494→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   495→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   496→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   497→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   498→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   499→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   500→            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
   501→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   502→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   503→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   504→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   505→            result.epics_updated += 1
   506→        else:
   507→            # Create new synthesis-cluster
   508→            cluster: Cluster = {
   509→                "name": epic_name,
   510→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   511→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   512→                "auto": True,
   513→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   514→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   515→                "user_modified": False,
   516→                "created_at": now,
   517→                "updated_at": now,
   518→                # Epic fields
   519→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   520→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   521→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   522→                "supersedes": [],
   523→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   524→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   525→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   526→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   527→                "source_clusters": [],
   528→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   529→                "synthesis_version": version,
   530→            }
   531→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   532→            result.epics_created += 1
   533→
   534→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   535→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   536→    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
   537→        fid = df.finding_id
   538→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   539→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
   540→        if fid in order:
   541→            order.remove(fid)
   542→        skipped[fid] = {
   543→            "finding_id": fid,
   544→            "kind": "synthesized_out",
   545→            "reason": df.reason,
   546→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   547→            "attestation": None,
   548→            "created_at": now,
   549→            "review_after": None,
   550→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   551→        }
   552→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   553→
   554→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   555→    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
   556→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   557→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   558→                order.remove(fid)
   559→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   560→                skipped[fid] = {
   561→                    "finding_id": fid,
   562→                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
   563→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   564→                    "note": None,
   565→                    "attestation": None,
   566→                    "created_at": now,
   567→                    "review_after": None,
   568→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   569→                }
   570→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   571→
   572→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   573→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   574→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   575→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   576→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   577→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   578→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   579→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   580→
   581→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   582→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   583→    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
   584→    new_order: list[str] = []
   585→    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
   586→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
   587→        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   588→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   589→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   590→    order.clear()
   591→    order.extend(new_order)
   592→
   593→    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
   594→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   595→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   596→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   597→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   598→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   599→    )
   600→
   601→    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
   602→        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
   603→        "last_run": now,
   604→        "version": version,
   605→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   606→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   607→        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
   608→        "trigger": trigger,
   609→    }
   610→    plan["updated"] = now
   611→
   612→    return result
   613→
   614→
   615→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   616→# Top-level orchestrator
   617→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   618→
   619→@dataclass
   620→class TriageDeps:
   621→    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
   622→
   623→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   624→
   625→
   626→def triage_epics(
   627→    plan: PlanModel,
   628→    state: StateModel,
   629→    *,
   630→    deps: TriageDeps | None = None,
   631→    dry_run: bool = False,
   632→    trigger: str = "manual",
   633→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   634→    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   635→
   636→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   637→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   638→
   639→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   640→    """
   641→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   642→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   643→
   644→    prompt = build_triage_prompt(si)
   645→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   646→
   647→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   648→        result = TriageMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   649→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   650→        return result
   651→
   652→    # Call LLM
   653→    try:
   654→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   655→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   656→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   657→        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   658→        result = TriageMutationResult()
   659→        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
   660→        return result
   661→
   662→    synthesis = parse_triage_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   663→    return apply_triage_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
   664→
   665→
   666→__all__ = [
   667→    "DismissedFinding",
   668→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   669→    "TriageDeps",
   670→    "TriageInput",
   671→    "TriageMutationResult",
   672→    "TriageResult",
   673→    "apply_triage_to_plan",
   674→    "build_triage_prompt",
   675→    "collect_triage_input",
   676→    "detect_recurring_patterns",
   677→    "extract_finding_citations",
   678→    "last_real_review_timestamp",
   679→    "parse_triage_result",
   680→    "triage_epics",
   681→]
   682→

  "content": "\"\"\"Shared triage guardrail helpers for command entrypoints.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n\nfrom desloppify.app.commands.helpers.display import short_finding_id\nfrom desloppify.core.exception_sets import PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS\nfrom desloppify.core.output_api import colorize\nfrom desloppify.engine.plan import (\n    compute_new_finding_ids,\n    is_triage_stale,\n    load_plan,\n    triage_phase_banner,\n)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TriageGuardrailResult:\n    \"\"\"Structured result from triage staleness detection.\"\"\"\n\n    is_stale: bool = False\n    new_ids: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)\n    _plan: dict | None = field(default=None, repr=False)\n\n\ndef triage_guardrail_status(\n    *,\n    plan: dict | None = None,\n    state: dict | None = None,\n) -> TriageGuardrailResult:\n    \"\"\"Pure detection: is triage stale? Returns structured result, no side effects.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        resolved_plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else load_plan()\n    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:\n        return TriageGuardrailResult()\n\n    resolved_state = state or {}\n\n    if not is_triage_stale(resolved_plan, resolved_state):\n        return TriageGuardrailResult(_plan=resolved_plan)\n\n    new_ids: set[str] = set()\n    if resolved_state:\n        new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(resolved_plan, resolved_state)\n\n    return TriageGuardrailResult(is_stale=True, new_ids=new_ids, _plan=resolved_plan)\n\n\ndef print_triage_guardrail_info(\n    *,\n    plan: dict | None = None,\n    state: dict | None = None,\n) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Print yellow info banner if triage is stale. Returns True if banner was shown.\"\"\"\n    result = triage_guardrail_status(plan=plan, state=state)\n    if not result.is_stale:\n        return False\n\n    if result.new_ids:\n        print(colorize(\n            f\"  {len(result.new_ids)} new review finding(s) not yet triaged.\",\n            \"yellow\",\n        ))\n\n    if result._plan is not None:\n        banner = triage_phase_banner(result._plan)\n        if banner:\n            print(colorize(f\"  {banner}\", \"yellow\"))\n\n    return True\n\n\ndef require_triage_current_or_exit(\n    *,\n    state: dict,\n    bypass: bool = False,\n    attest: str = \"\",\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Gate: exit(1) if triage is stale and not bypassed. Name signals the exit.\"\"\"\n    result = triage_guardrail_status(state=state)\n    if not result.is_stale:\n        return\n\n    if bypass and attest and len(attest.strip()) >= 30:\n        print(colorize(\n            \"  Triage guardrail bypassed with attestation.\",\n            \"yellow\",\n        ))\n        return\n\n    new_ids = result.new_ids\n    print(colorize(\n        f\"\\n  BLOCKED: {len(new_ids) or 'some'} new review finding(s) have not been triaged.\",\n        \"red\",\n    ))\n    if new_ids:\n        for fid in sorted(new_ids)[:5]:\n            f = state.get(\"findings\", {}).get(fid, {})\n            print(colorize(f\"    * [{short_finding_id(fid)}] {f.get('summary', '')}\", \"red\"))\n        if len(new_ids) > 5:\n            print(colorize(f\"    ... and {len(new_ids) - 5} more\", \"dim\"))\n    print()\n    print(colorize(\"  NEXT STEP: desloppify plan triage\", \"yellow\"))\n    print(colorize(\n        \"  (Review new findings, then either --confirm-existing or re-plan.)\",\n        \"dim\",\n    ))\n    print()\n    print(colorize(\"  View new items:  desloppify plan queue --sort recent\", \"dim\"))\n    print(colorize(\n        '  To bypass: --force-resolve --attest \"I understand the plan may be stale...\"',\n        \"dim\",\n    ))\n    print()\n    sys.exit(1)\n\n\n# Backward-compatible aliases\nSynthesisGuardrailResult = TriageGuardrailResult\nsynthesis_guardrail_status = triage_guardrail_status\nprint_synthesis_guardrail_info = print_triage_guardrail_info\nrequire_synthesis_current_or_exit = require_triage_current_or_exit\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"TriageGuardrailResult\",\n    \"print_triage_guardrail_info\",\n    \"require_triage_current_or_exit\",\n    \"triage_guardrail_status\",\n    # Backward-compatible aliases\n    \"SynthesisGuardrailResult\",\n    \"print_synthesis_guardrail_info\",\n    \"require_synthesis_current_or_exit\",\n    \"synthesis_guardrail_status\",\n]\n"
}
