  "old_string": "def _blocked_synthesis_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for synthesis stages that can't run yet.\n\n    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —\n    no state needed, no queue item construction.\n    \"\"\"\n    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.synthesis_playbook import SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES\n    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SYNTHESIS_IDS, SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS\n\n    order_set = set(plan.get(\"queue_order\", []))\n    present = order_set & SYNTHESIS_IDS\n    if not present:\n        return {}\n\n    confirmed = set(plan.get(\"epic_synthesis_meta\", {}).get(\"synthesis_stages\", {}).keys())\n    stage_names = (\"observe\", \"reflect\", \"organize\", \"commit\")\n\n    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}\n    for sid, name in zip(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):\n        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:\n            continue\n        deps = SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())\n        unmet = sorted(\n            f\"synthesis::{dep}\" for dep in deps\n            if f\"synthesis::{dep}\" in present and dep not in confirmed\n        )\n        if unmet:\n            blocked[sid] = unmet\n    return blocked",
  "new_string": "def _blocked_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for triage stages that can't run yet.\n\n    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —\n    no state needed, no queue item construction.\n    \"\"\"\n    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.triage_playbook import TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES\n    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import TRIAGE_IDS, TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS\n\n    order_set = set(plan.get(\"queue_order\", []))\n    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS\n    if not present:\n        return {}\n\n    confirmed = set(plan.get(\"epic_triage_meta\", {}).get(\"triage_stages\", {}).keys())\n    stage_names = (\"observe\", \"reflect\", \"organize\", \"commit\")\n\n    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}\n    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):\n        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:\n            continue\n        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())\n        unmet = sorted(\n            f\"triage::{dep}\" for dep in deps\n            if f\"triage::{dep}\" in present and dep not in confirmed\n        )\n        if unmet:\n            blocked[sid] = unmet\n    return blocked"
}

   101→def triage_phase_banner(plan: PlanModel) -> str:
   102→    """Return a banner string when triage stage IDs are in the queue."""
   103→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   104→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   105→    has_triage = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS) or TRIAGE_ID in order
   106→    if not has_triage:
   107→        return ""
   108→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   109→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   110→    completed = [s for s in ("observe", "reflect", "organize") if s in stages]
   111→    if completed:
   112→        return (
   113→            f"TRIAGE MODE ({len(completed)}/4 stages complete) — "
   114→            "complete all stages to exit. Run: desloppify plan triage"
   115→        )
   116→    return (
   117→        "TRIAGE MODE — review findings need analysis before fixing. "
   118→        "Run: desloppify plan triage"
   119→    )
   120→
   121→
   122→synthesis_phase_banner = triage_phase_banner

   104→def migrate_v5_to_v6(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   105→    """Migrate v5 → v6: unified queue system."""
   106→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   107→        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,
   108→        WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID,
   109→    )
   110→
   111→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   112→
   113→    # Handle legacy synthesis::pending or triage::pending
   114→    for legacy_pending in ("synthesis::pending", "triage::pending"):
   115→        if legacy_pending in order:
   116→            idx = order.index(legacy_pending)
   117→            order.remove(legacy_pending)
   118→            meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {}))
   119→            confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", meta.get("synthesis_stages", {})).keys())
   120→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   121→            to_inject = [
   122→                stage_id
   123→                for stage_id, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)
   124→                if name not in confirmed and stage_id not in order
   125→            ]
   126→            for offset, stage_id in enumerate(to_inject):
   127→                order.insert(idx + offset, stage_id)
   128→            break
   129→
   130→    if plan.pop("pending_plan_gate", False):
   131→        if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID not in order:
   132→            insert_at = 0
   133→            for idx, finding_id in enumerate(order):
   134→                if finding_id.startswith("triage::") or finding_id.startswith("synthesis::"):
   135→                    insert_at = idx + 1
   136→            order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   137→    else:
   138→        plan.pop("pending_plan_gate", None)
   139→
   140→
   141→def migrate_synthesis_to_triage(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   142→    """Migrate synthesis::* → triage::* naming throughout the plan.
   143→
   144→    - Renames ``synthesis::*`` IDs to ``triage::*`` in ``queue_order`` and ``skipped``
   145→    - Renames ``epic_synthesis_meta`` key to ``epic_triage_meta``
   146→    - Renames ``synthesis_stages`` to ``triage_stages`` inside that meta dict
   147→    - Renames ``synthesized_ids`` to ``triaged_ids`` inside that meta dict
   148→    - Renames ``synthesis_version`` to ``triage_version`` in cluster dicts
   149→    """
   150→    # Rename synthesis::* IDs in queue_order
   151→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   152→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   153→        if fid.startswith("synthesis::"):
   154→            order[i] = "triage::" + fid[len("synthesis::"):]
   155→
   156→    # Rename synthesis::* IDs in skipped
   157→    skipped: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   158→    synth_keys = [k for k in skipped if k.startswith("synthesis::")]
   159→    for old_key in synth_keys:
   160→        new_key = "triage::" + old_key[len("synthesis::"):]
   161→        entry = skipped.pop(old_key)
   162→        if isinstance(entry, dict):
   163→            entry["finding_id"] = new_key
   164→        skipped[new_key] = entry
   165→
   166→    # Rename epic_synthesis_meta → epic_triage_meta
   167→    if "epic_synthesis_meta" in plan:
   168→        meta = plan.pop("epic_synthesis_meta")
   169→        if isinstance(meta, dict):
   170→            # Rename synthesis_stages → triage_stages
   171→            if "synthesis_stages" in meta:
   172→                meta["triage_stages"] = meta.pop("synthesis_stages")
   173→            # Rename synthesized_ids → triaged_ids
   174→            if "synthesized_ids" in meta:
   175→                meta["triaged_ids"] = meta.pop("synthesized_ids")
   176→        plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   177→
   178→    # Rename synthesis_version → triage_version in clusters
   179→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   180→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict):
   181→            continue
   182→        if "synthesis_version" in cluster:
   183→            cluster["triage_version"] = cluster.pop("synthesis_version")
   184→
   185→
   186→__all__ = [
   187→    "ensure_container_types",
   188→    "migrate_deferred_to_skipped",
   189→    "migrate_epics_to_clusters",
   190→    "migrate_synthesis_to_triage",
   191→    "migrate_v5_to_v6",
   192→    "normalize_cluster_defaults",
   193→]

     def _enforce_workflow_stage_order(items: list[dict]) -> None:
         """Re-sort workflow_stage items in-place: unblocked before blocked."""
         stage_entries = [(i, item) for i, item in enumerate(items)
                          if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage"]
         if len(stage_entries) <= 1:
             return
         sorted_stages = sorted(
             [item for _, item in stage_entries],
             key=lambda it: (1 if it.get("is_blocked") else 0, int(it.get("stage_index", 0))),
         )
         for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
             items[idx] = replacement
